title: Brand Partnership Outreach Specialist — Open Direct Wholesale Accounts With Brands
description:
Apply directly through our website.

About us:

Trumonk Distribution Inc. is a distribution company in Canada and the US. We help grow brands through exclusive partnerships and retail outreach. 



What you will do:

- Open brand-direct wholesale accounts: research a brand, find the person who handles distributor accounts, and get a reply

- Do the homework before every outreach: study the brand's website, listings, and market, and find the one problem we can solve for them and how we can help

- Audit each brand and its competitors using our audit template: find the problems, show the brand the fix and the value, so they agree to partner

- Guide brands through Brand Registry enrolment where they are not enrolled, and help them build out their brand page and A+ Content

- Write short, personalized outreach
s for each brand, no copied templates, no generic blasts

- Cold call brands when
 gets no reply, and follow up by
 and phone until you get a clear yes or no, usually 3 to 5 follow-ups, then monthly

- Get brands to a call, a wholesale price list, and a first purchase order

- Ask for referrals and supplier lists when a brand says no

- Keep a clean outreach tracker with the status of every brand

- Send a short daily update on replies, calls, and blockers

- Submit a weekly report: replies, calls, accounts opened, pipeline status, and next week's targets



What this job is NOT:

This is not a product sourcing role. You will not be hunting profitable products on Amazon. Product research is handled separately. Your job is the reply: turning a brand into an open account.



Must have:

- Proof of wholesale accounts you personally opened in the last year, with a first order or LOA you can show

- At least one outreach
 you wrote that got a reply from a brand, share it in your application

- Cold calling experience: comfortable calling a brand you have never spoken to, comfortable with a live role-play test

- Expert ability to audit a brand and its competitors and turn the findings into fixes and value that win the partnership

- Working knowledge of A+ Content, Amazon SEO, and PPC, and how to guide a brand through Brand Registry enrolment

- Strong personalized
 writing, short and specific to each brand

- Follow-up discipline: you do not stop after one

- Strong written and spoken English, prompt daily communication



Nice to have:

- Existing contacts in Health and Beauty, Food and Gourmet, Pets, Supplements, Automobile, or Home, Craft and DIY

- Experience finding decision makers and supplier contact details

- Experience with brand audits, listing checks, or Amazon brand pages

- Product research knowledge (Amazon product vetting, Keepa, SmartScout) — useful background, but this is not a product sourcing role



How we work:

- Work remotely

- Paid trial before any longer commitment

- Paid test task before hiring: pick one brand, do the homework, find the decision maker, and write the outreach
 you would send, plus a role-play cold call test

- Never promise a brand exclusivity, volume guarantees, or terms Trumonk has not approved



Compensation:

To be discussed during the interview. Please include your expected monthly salary in your application.



To apply, include in your application:

1. One outreach
 you wrote that got a brand reply

2. One wholesale account you opened, with proof

3. What you would do after a brand ignores your first two
s

Applications without these three will not be considered.

title: Director, Global Alliances – Accenture
UGC Creator Scout & Manager (Part-Time, Flexible Hours)
description:
DESCRIPTION:

We're a small, very flexible remote marketing team that works over Slack, plus one weekly team call. We're looking for someone to find and manage UGC creators who make short videos for our ads.



SCOUTING

- Find UGC creators with small followings (under 10k) on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts who make natural, talking-to-camera style videos.

- Get each creator's price for one 15-45 second ad video, and shortlist only those who charge $8 or less per video.

- Log everyone in a Google Sheet: handle, platform, follower count, sample video links, country, language, price per video and turnaround time.



MANAGING

- Send our video requests to creators with clear briefs, track deadlines, and chase late deliveries.

- Check each video matches the brief before it reaches us, and ask for fixes when needed.

- Keep creators happy and motivated: quick replies, feedback on their work, shout-outs for good videos, and making sure they're paid on time.

- Send a weekly update on new creators, videos delivered, and who's doing well or falling behind.



THE KIND OF PERSON WE WANT

We don't care when you work. Go to the gym, run errands, live your life. What matters is that you're present and positive. Never leave the team on read. If you can't reply properly right now, just say "at the gym, back in 30 min" and come back when you said you would. Give updates without being chased, flag problems early, try a fix yourself before asking, and be a real team player.



REQUIREMENTS

- Experience finding or managing creators, influencers or freelancers

- A good eye for videos that would work as ads

- Organized, reliable, and good with Google Sheets

- Friendly, clear communicator; other languages are a bonus



TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "UGC". Tell us how you'd find good creators at $8 or less per video and keep them motivated, and paste links to 3 creators under 10k followers you think would fit. Shortlisted applicants will do a small paid test: find 20 creators who fit.

title: Remote Sales Representative / Appointment Setter – U.S. Trucking Industry

Roanex is a U.S.-based transportation management software company helping trucking businesses manage loads, drivers, dispatching, documents, and invoicing in one platform.



We’re looking for a motivated, confident salesperson to help us grow.

Compensation

Send us:

We’re looking for someone who can start conversations, build relationships, and help trucking companies discover a better way to run their business.

title: B2B Cold Caller / Outbound Appointment Setter (Fluent English) – Flexible US Hours ($5 - $7/hr + Bonuses)
description:
Job Type:



Part-Time (10–20 Hours/Week to start) with potential to grow into Full-Time

Salary: $5.00 – $7.00 / hour (depending on experience) + $25.00 cash bonus per qualified call/appointment booked



Overview:



MADDS Marketing is a boutique digital marketing and web design agency based in Nevada, USA. We partner with established local trade contractors (well drillers, heavy equipment/diesel mechanics, roofing companies, tree services, and plumbers) to build turn-key mobile authority websites that capture high-ticket emergency calls.



We are looking for a confident, articulate, and friendly Outbound Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to join our team.



You do NOT have to close deals or sell anything over the phone. Your sole objective is to call verified business owners, introduce a custom 45-second mobile preview we already created for their company, text/email them the link, and book a brief 10-minute follow-up call with our founder.



What You Will Do:

Place 25–40 outbound calls per day to pre-qualified Nevada business owners using our VoIP phone system.

Follow our proven 60-to-90 second cold call battlecards and scripts.

Speak casually and professionally with owners and gatekeepers (dispatchers/office managers).

Deliver the value hook: show them how our pre-built interactive mobile preview helps them capture direct high-ticket calls instead of losing jobs to corporate franchises.

Send the custom preview link to the owner via text/email while on the call or immediately after.

Book interested prospects into our calendar for a quick 10-minute walkthrough.

Update simple call notes in our database (Google Sheets / CRM).



Working Hours:

Pacific Standard Time (PST): Monday through Thursday, between 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM PST (approx. 2 to 4 hours per day).

Philippine Time (PHT): 11:30 PM – 4:30 AM (or early morning). Exact schedule can be discussed.



Compensation & Perks:

Base Pay: $5.00 – $7.00 / hour (bi-weekly via Wise or PayPal).

Performance Bonus: $25.00 bonus for every qualified owner walkthrough call you schedule that attends.

Pre-Built Leads & Scripts: You will receive a clean list with verified owner names, mobile numbers, and pre-built interactive links. No prospecting or searching required.

Warm Lead Context: Many prospects have already received an introductory text from our office, making the calls warm rather than completely cold.

Growth: Opportunity to move into full-time hours, higher base pay, and closing roles.



How to Apply (IMPORTANT):



To ensure you read this entire post and have strong attention to detail:



Reply with the subject line: "MADDS Outbound Caller - [Your First and Last Name]"

Record a short 45–60 second voice recording on vocaroo.com

 reading the short script below, and paste the Vocaroo link in your reply:



"Hi Jim, this is [Your Name] calling from Madison's office here in Nevada. I know you're probably out on a job site right now so I’ll be super quick. We noticed your crew has a great reputation for well drilling across Nye County, but when property owners search online on their phones, you don’t have a direct mobile site—so a lot of those high-ticket calls go to corporate franchises instead. Madison actually put together a quick 45-second interactive mobile preview showing what yours could look like. I can text the link right over to your cell—did you want to take a quick look?"



Briefly mention your previous cold calling experience with US-based businesses.

Confirm your home office setup (headset brand, internet speed, and computer specs).



Applications without a Vocaroo voice recording link will not be reviewed.

Someone who can create consistent AI influencers appearing in different outfits, poses, hairstyles, and environments, including lifestyle, fashion, travel, and everyday social media content.



**Character consistency and realism are our top priorities.**



### How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. **Portfolio** – Examples of AI-generated human models you personally created.

2. **Consistency Samples** – At least 5–10 images of the SAME AI character in different poses, outfits, and environments.

3. **Video Samples** – AI-generated videos demonstrating realistic human movements.

4. **Tools & Workflow** – List the software you use and how you maintain character consistency.

5. **Pricing** – Rates for character creation, individual images, and videos.

6. **Turnaround Time** – Estimated production time for initial character creation and ongoing content.



### IMPORTANT



We are NOT looking for someone who simply enters prompts into an AI image generator.



We need an experienced professional with expertise in character training, identity consistency, photorealism, and AI image and video production.

We help businesses build their pipelines, strengthen their marketing and deliver dependable services. We are growing our remote team, initially focused on the UK, with Australia in our wider plans.



The opportunity

We need a capable marketing practitioner who can turn a brief into clear content, consistent social activity and measurable campaign delivery. You will support Qore’s own marketing and agreed client work, adapting content to different brands and audiences. This role suits someone who can write well, produce practical creative assets, maintain basic website content and work closely with sales.

Works with the Marketing Manager, Managing Director and sales team.

Key responsibilities



Create useful and persuasive content

 campaigns, social posts, case studies and sales-support content suited to the audience and objective.

 and content campaigns with sales outreach. Maintain consistent messaging and help turn campaign engagement into a useful follow-up.

• Track results, test messaging and formats, and recommend changes. Explain performance using relevant engagement, traffic, enquiry and conversion measures.



Apply SEO and website fundamentals

• Carry out basic keyword and search-intent research. Improve headings, page titles, metadata, internal links, image descriptions and content structure.

• Publish and update pages through a CMS such as WordPress or an equivalent platform. Check links, forms, mobile presentation and basic usability.

• Use tools such as Google Analytics and Search Console to understand performance and identify issues. Apply campaign tracking links where appropriate.

• Recognise when specialist development, design or technical SEO support is needed and prepare a clear brief. Advanced web development is outside the core scope.



Required skills and experience

• At least two years of relevant digital marketing experience, with a portfolio showing work you personally created and delivered.

• Very high written and spoken English proficiency. You must write accurate, persuasive UK-market content with minimal editing and communicate confidently with colleagues and clients.

• Strong copywriting, editing and content-repurposing skills across web,
 and social channels.

• Practical social media management experience, including planning, scheduling, publishing, community interaction and reporting.

• Sound fundamental knowledge of SEO, website content management and basic web usability.

• Ability to create professional visual content and make straightforward video edits using suitable design and editing tools.

• Working knowledge of analytics, campaign measurement and the difference between audience activity and meaningful business outcomes.

• Good organisation, attention to detail and the ability to manage several briefs, deadlines and brand voices without losing quality.

• Willingness and reliable availability to work UK business hours, with clear remote communication and ownership of agreed deliverables.



Preferred experience

• Experience in an outsourced marketing company, digital agency or another business delivering work for several clients.

• Experience marketing B2B services, MSP or IT services, professional services or SaaS to UK or Australian audiences.

• Experience with
 marketing, basic marketing automation, CRM handoffs or paid-campaign support. Any advanced paid-media responsibilities will be scoped separately.



What success looks like

Success means accurate, on-brand content is published on time, social channels are managed consistently and campaign reporting leads to practical improvements. We will agree measures around content quality, relevant engagement, search and website performance, enquiries and contribution to the sales pipeline.



Availability and contractor terms

The role is full time, 8 hours per day. However, for the right candidate we can be flexible. Reliable availability during agreed UK business hours is essential, including adjustment when UK clocks change. Exact working windows and weekly hours will be agreed before the engagement begins. Tell us your earliest realistic start date and any availability constraints.

• This is a long-term independent contractor engagement. The gross fee, service scope, weekly hours, payment currency and invoicing terms will be agreed in writing. Any incentive arrangement must be agreed separately.

• You must independently manage and fund the legal, administrative, operational and financial responsibilities of providing your services: relevant registrations and permissions, tax returns and payments, bookkeeping, invoicing, applicable social contributions, insurance, healthcare and provision for time off.

• Provide and maintain your own suitable computer, headset, secure workspace, reliable internet and power, and practical backup arrangements. Include your normal equipment, connectivity, utilities, administration and operating costs in your quoted fee.

• No separate employee benefits, allowances or reimbursements are included unless agreed in writing or required by applicable law. Access to Qore or client systems and any campaign-specific costs will be agreed separately; do not incur expenditure on their behalf without approval.

• Organise your work independently to meet agreed outcomes, UK availability, confidentiality and security requirements. The written agreement and actual working arrangements must comply with applicable law; statutory rights and obligations cannot be waived by describing the engagement as contracting.



Apply now

title: Scheduler & Recruiting Specialist
description:
# Now Hiring: Remote Scheduler & Recruitment Specialist

**Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | Established U.S. Cleaning Company**



Are you exceptionally organized, a natural problem-solver, and someone who enjoys putting all the pieces of a puzzle together? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are exactly alike?



If so, we would love to meet you!



Maid For You is an established, independently owned residential cleaning company based in Concord, New Hampshire, USA. We have been in business for over 20 years and have exciting growth plans ahead of us.



We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented professional based in the Philippines to join our growing office team in a long-term, full-time remote position combining scheduling and recruiting.



 Position Details



- **Starting pay:** $8.00 USD per hour

- **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

- **Location:** Remote – Philippines

- **Employment:** Full-time, long-term

- **Weekends:** Saturday and Sunday off

- **Growth:** Opportunities for professional development, increased responsibilities, and compensation growth based on demonstrated competencies and performance.



 Scheduling Responsibilities



Scheduling will be your primary responsibility. This is much more than simply managing a calendar!



- Coordinate daily and recurring cleaning appointments.

- Manage cleaning technician schedules, availability, and workloads.

- Optimize driving routes and minimize unnecessary travel time.

- Handle employee call-outs, cancellations, and last-minute schedule changes.

- Identify scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve them.

- Maintain accurate customer and scheduling records.

- Coordinate with our sales, customer service, and field teams.

- Ensure efficient scheduling while balancing customer satisfaction, employee satisfaction, and company profitability.

- Anticipate potential scheduling challenges before they become problems.



 Recruiting Responsibilities



During available time between scheduling responsibilities, you will help us build our growing team of exceptional cleaning technicians.



- Manage job postings and incoming applications.

- Review résumés and screen potential candidates.

- Conduct preliminary interviews.

- Coordinate interviews with our leadership team.

- Communicate with applicants throughout the hiring process.

- Maintain accurate applicant records and recruiting pipelines.

- Proactively identify opportunities to attract qualified candidates.

- Support our goal of becoming one of the best places to work in New Hampshire!



## What We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



- Has previous experience in scheduling, dispatching, recruiting, or operations.

- Has excellent written and verbal English communication and comprehension skills.

- Possesses exceptional attention to detail.

- Demonstrates strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

- Can confidently manage multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed.

- Is comfortable working with numbers, schedules, and technology.

- Can work independently and exercise sound judgment.

- Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through consistently.

- Is proactive rather than reactive.

- Welcomes constructive feedback and enjoys learning.

- Is looking for a stable, long-term career rather than a temporary assignment.



Previous experience working with a U.S.-based residential cleaning company or another field-service business is highly preferred.



## Technology & Remote Work Requirements



- Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection.

- Backup plan for internet and power interruptions.

- Quiet, professional work environment.

- Comfortable participating in frequent video meetings with your camera on.

- Ability to learn and navigate multiple software platforms.



Experience with scheduling software, CRM systems, Slack, ClickUp, Google Workspace, or MaidCentral is a plus.



 Why Join Maid For You?



We believe that exceptional customer experiences begin with exceptional employee experiences.



Our core values are **Honesty, Integrity, Generosity, and Dependability.** We are committed to building a supportive, respectful workplace where our team members feel valued, have opportunities to grow, and take pride in the work they do.



We provide structured training, documented procedures, ongoing support, and opportunities for advancement as our company continues to grow.



We aren't simply looking for someone to fill a position. We're looking for someone who wants to become an integral part of our team for years to come.



 How to Apply



Please submit your updated résumé, an introductory video, and written answers to the following questions:



1. Tell us about your previous scheduling and dispatching experience.

2. Approximately how many employees did you schedule, how many appointments did you manage per day, and how many active customers did the company serve in total?

3. Tell us about your previous recruiting experience.

4. Describe a challenging scheduling situation you encountered and how you resolved it.

5. Are you comfortable working Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, including changes associated with U.S. daylight saving time?

6. What interests you about this position, and what are you looking for in a long-term employer?



 Required Introductory Video



We would love to get to know the person behind the résumé!



Please submit a short, 2–3 minute introductory video in English with your camera on, addressing the following:



- Introduce yourself and briefly share your professional background.

- Tell us what you enjoy most about scheduling and recruiting.

- Describe how you prioritize your responsibilities when multiple urgent requests come in at the same time.

- Tell us why you believe you would be a great addition to the Maid For You team.



Your video does not need to be professionally produced or edited. We would much rather see your authentic personality and natural communication style than a polished, scripted presentation.



You may submit your video using Loom, Google Drive, or another easily accessible video-sharing platform. Please ensure that your video link has the appropriate viewing permissions.



Application Checklist



- Updated résumé

- Written answers to all six application questions

- Introductory video link



To demonstrate your attention to detail, please include "Scheduling Detailer" in the subject line of your application.



**Only complete applications will be considered.**



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in an interview and complete a competency assessment as part of our hiring process.



We look forward to meeting our next amazing team member!

title: Procurement & Logistics Assistant
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Position: Procurement & Logistics Assistant

Job Type: Full-Time (Remote)

Work Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK Time



Position Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented, organized, and proactive Procurement & Logistics Assistant with experience in e-commerce and Amazon FBA operations.



In this role, you will support daily procurement, supplier coordination, inventory monitoring, international shipping, and third-party logistics (3PL) operations.



The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, strong organizational skills, and the ability to coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, and warehouses to ensure timely product deliveries and efficient supply chain operations.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Inventory & FBA Operations

- Assist in creating and monitoring Amazon FBA shipments through Seller Central.

- Track inbound shipments and coordinate deliveries to Amazon Fulfillment Centers.

- Monitor inventory levels, stock availability, and replenishment requirements.

- Ensure products meet Amazon packaging, labeling, and shipping requirements.

- Coordinate stock transfers between 3PL warehouses and Amazon fulfillment centers.



2. Procurement & Supplier Coordination

- Assist in preparing, issuing, and tracking purchase orders (POs).

- Communicate with local and international suppliers regarding production updates, pricing, and delivery schedules.

- Monitor supplier lead times and follow up on outstanding orders.

- Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier information, and order trackers.

- Assist in sourcing products and obtaining supplier quotations.



3. Logistics & Freight Coordination

- Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping agents, and 3PL providers.

- Track international shipments, particularly from China to the UK, US, and EU.

- Assist in preparing and organizing shipping documents, invoices, and packing lists.

- Monitor shipment delays and communicate updates to the relevant teams.

- Maintain accurate shipping and logistics trackers.



4. Inventory Monitoring & Reporting

- Update inventory spreadsheets and stock movement records.

- Assist in monitoring reorder points and identifying potential stock shortages.

- Reconcile inventory information between Amazon Seller Central and 3PL warehouses.

- Prepare regular procurement, inventory, and shipment status reports.

- Support the team in maintaining accurate supply chain records.



Qualifications & Skill Requirements



Required Experience

- At least 1–2 years of experience in procurement, logistics, supply chain, or e-commerce operations.

- Experience using Amazon Seller Central, particularly FBA inventory and shipment management.

- Familiarity with international shipping, freight forwarding, and 3PL operations.

- Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

- Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

- Comfortable communicating with international suppliers and logistics partners.

- Willing to use Hubstaff for time tracking.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience coordinating shipments from China to international markets.

- Familiarity with Amazon FBA prep centers and warehouse operations.

- Knowledge of purchase orders, inventory forecasting, and landed cost calculations.

- Experience using inventory management software or ERP systems.

- Previous experience working with Amazon private-label or e-commerce brands.



 How to Apply



Interested candidates should send a message with the subject:



"Procurement & Logistics Assistant Application"



Please include the following:



- Updated CV or resume link.

- A brief cover letter highlighting your years of relevant procurement and logistics experience.

- Details of your experience with Amazon Seller Central, suppliers, and freight coordination.

- Expected monthly salary in USD.

- Earliest available start date.



Applications with relevant Amazon FBA and logistics experience will be prioritized.

Hey there! We are looking for a highly organised and energetic Full Time Virtual Assistant based in the Philippines to join Number 90 — a bar/restaurant on the canal in Hackney Wick, London, with two nightclub rooms attached, a very busy and vibrant place.



You'll be supporting Marilo, our corporate sales lead, in the corporate booking department — helping fill our spaces with corporate events of all kinds. The role covers admin, contracts, marketing research, and cold calling, so alongside being organised, you'll need to be genuinely comfortable picking up the phone and talking to people. If cold calling makes you want to hide, this probably isn't the role for you!



Number 90 is:

???? 

???? 

???? 



We'd love someone looking for a long-term position — we already have 4 team members from the Philippines who've worked with us for 2+ years on average, it's all down to how dedicated and result-driven the team is — keen to bring their own ideas to the table, and excited to become a real part of a small, close-knit team.



You'll need to be confident, an excellent communicator, and write and speak English to a high level. This is a full-time role — 8 hours a day, Monday to Friday — with your working hours running through to 4pm UK time, so please only apply if you're able to work into UK evening hours from the Philippines. Please make sure this schedule is something you can commit to consistently and long-term before applying.



Before you apply:

•	Please don't reply to this ad on OnlineJobs.ph — follow the steps below instead.

•	Also note in advance that we do use OnlineJobs' Timeproof software, which takes a screenshot of your computer every 10 minutes. If you don't want to use it, please don't apply — it's a deal breaker for us.



To kick off the process, create a Google Drive folder titled: your full name + your superpower.

In the folder, we want to see:

???? Introduce Yourself: A short video (2 minute max) introducing yourself and telling us why you specifically want this role — not a list of your skills, but why this opportunity excites you. Include your name and today's date in the video.

???? DISC Profile: Complete your DISC profile via the link below and upload the PDF to your folder.



???? CV Upload: Add your CV to the folder.

???? Life-Changing Book: A short document titled "The Book That's Changed My Life" — in 10 lines or fewer, tell us about a book that changed your life and why others should read it.



Once your folder is ready, share it with 
 giving her Editor or Viewer access. Then email us at 
 to let us know you've completed the task — include the name of the folder and the link.

When you apply, add "Superpower Engaged" as the last line of your message.



Benefits:



$600 salary per month

13th month pay, paid in December (pro-rata in your first year)

20 days paid holiday per year (inclusive of Philippine public holidays)

Up to 5 paid sick days per year



After 3 months' probation (or earlier if you're exceeding expectations):

Unlock a bonus scheme: earn a percentage on any upsells you generate on events (e.g., upselling a Karaoke add-on at £200 could earn you around 10%, roughly £20–25)

Earn a fee for any events you personally bring in through your own actions (e.g., cold calling) — the size of this depends on the event, but a strong booking can easily be worth $100 or more



After 6 months:

HMO cover unlocked — paid every 6 months (i.e., renewed twice a year, rather than a single annual upfront payment)



Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Appointment Setter - Phone, US Business Funding (Night Shift)

title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Company

We are a full-service creative agency helping brands grow through strategic design, branding, content production, web development, and digital marketing. Our team combines creativity, data, and customer insights to build cohesive brand experiences that drive meaningful business results.



We’re Hiring

We’re looking for a talented, self-driven Graphic Designer with strong creative instincts and a strategic approach to design. The ideal candidate can work independently, understand brand guidelines, and turn creative direction or basic wireframes into polished, high-quality visual assets.



What You’ll Do

- Design social media ads, organic content, and digital marketing creatives.

- Create website banners and other digital advertising assets.

- Design engaging social media content, including Reels and animated visuals.

- Apply brand guidelines consistently while using strong judgment in color, typography, layout, and visual hierarchy.

- Turn briefs, concepts, and wireframes into compelling designs with minimal direction.

- Research industry trends, audiences, and competitors to inform creative decisions.

- Develop design concepts that support different brands, services, and marketing objectives.

- Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to deliver high-quality assets.



Requirements

- Proven experience in graphic design, preferably in a creative agency or marketing environment.

- Strong portfolio showcasing social media ads, digital marketing assets, and brand-aligned creative work.

- Proficiency in Figma, Canva, and Adobe Creative Suite.

- Strong understanding of branding, color psychology, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy.

- Ability to work independently and turn creative direction into polished deliverables.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

- Proactive mindset, strong research skills, and an understanding of marketing-driven design.



Nice to Have

- Experience creating animated graphics and motion-based social content.

- Basic video editing skills, particularly for short-form social media content.

- Familiarity with UX/UI or front-end design.



What We’re Looking For

A creative, resourceful designer with strong visual instincts, strategic thinking, and the ability to elevate designs from good to great. Someone who takes initiative, brings fresh ideas to the table, and consistently delivers high-quality work without requiring extensive supervision.



Schedule

Part-time position

Must be available during morning hours in the Eastern Time Zone

title: Virtual Assistant: Online Fitness Coaching | min 5 hrs/week | Remote
description:
Hey, I'm Ash! I'm an online body recomposition coach for women, host of the Good to Great podcast, and a big believer that a little delusion is how big things get built.

My business is growing fast. I need someone to own the tasks that keep it moving, so I can stay focused on my clients. If you love Instagram and Canva and you're great at staying organised, keep reading.

What you'll do

• Keep client admin tight: flag upcoming renewals and clients who aren't keeping up, and off board finished clients from Slack and Trainerize

• Look after Stripe payments: send invoices for late payments and follow up with clients in Slack

• Repurpose podcast reels to YouTube and Instagram trial reels

• Turn client wins into a Canva post every 1-3 week, stories weekly.

• Find podcast guest spots and speaking gigs for me

• Help me set up and run Go High Level

You're my person if

• You've used Go High Level and Canva, and you know your way around Instagram DMs

• Your DMs sound human and warm, never salesy or copy-paste - i HATE AI scripts!!!

• You do what you say you'll do, without being chased

• You can work a short block most weekdays, with some overlap with Australian (AEST) hours

• Bonus: you've used Stripe, or worked in the health or fitness coaching space

The details

• 5 hours a week, remote, contractor

• $4-6 per hour, depending on experience, starting with a paid 4-week trial

• Weekly performance bonus: an extra $5 for every qualified call you book that shows up

• Grow with me: you start at 5 hours, and your hours grow as the business does

• Start date: week of 7 December

How to apply

 
 by Sunday 29 November with the subject line "Good to Great VA" and include:

1.  A short intro and your hourly rate

2.  A 2-3 minute Loom about you and the tools you've used

3.  The first DM you'd send someone who just followed my account (Something fun and outside the box, I don't do boring!)

Applications without that subject line won't be opened!!

title: Sales & Customer Service Specialist (AI-Savvy) - 1026
description:
Important: Please read the entire job ad. Applications that don't follow the instructions will be automatically disqualified.



Remote (UK business hours) | Front Row Furniture

Full-time | 40-45 hours per week

Salary: Competitive, based on skills and experience | TBD



About Us:

Front Row Furniture is a trusted UK-based supplier of quality contract furniture for the events and hospitality industries. Our clients range from event planners and venues to restaurants and hotels, and they rely on us for stylish, durable and affordable furniture backed by excellent service and reliable delivery. We're a small, close-knit remote team, and we're actively bringing AI into how we work across sales, customer service and operations.



The Role:

We're looking for an exceptional Sales and Customer Service Specialist who is tech friendly and genuinely enthusiastic about AI. You'll be the first point of contact for many of our customers, handling enquiries by phone,
, website live chat and online marketplaces, turning leads into orders and making sure every customer gets a quick, clear and helpful answer.



You won't use AI just because you're told to. You're the kind of person who already uses tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to work faster and smarter, and you're excited to help us build better ways of working.



What You'll Do:

*Sales and lead handling: understand what customers need, recommend the right products, send quotes and follow up until the order is secured.

*Customer service: respond quickly and clearly to enquiries by phone,
 and live chat, and handle questions, concerns and after-sales support with a solutions-first attitude.

*Order and delivery updates: keep customers informed on stock, dispatch and delivery, and work with our logistics side to resolve any issues.

*Platform management: monitor and update product listings and messages on our website and online marketplaces (e.g. eBay, Gumtree, Amazon).

*Systems and records: keep leads, orders and customer records accurate and up to date in our systems (such as Odoo and Google Sheets).

*AI in your daily work: use AI tools to draft replies, research products, summarise information and speed up routine tasks, always checking the output before anything goes to a customer.

*Process improvement: follow our SOPs, suggest improvements, and share ideas on where AI and automation could save time.

*Feedback loop: pass customer insights back to the team to help improve our products, processes and messaging.



What Success Looks Like:

*Enquiries are answered quickly and professionally, and more of them turn into orders.

*Customers always know where their order is.

*Records are accurate, so the rest of the team can rely on them.

*You regularly find smarter, faster ways to do the job, including with AI.

*You become a trusted, go-to person for both customers and colleagues.



What We're Looking For:

*1-3+ years of experience in sales or customer service, ideally with UK, US or international clients.

*Clear, confident spoken and written English. UK or neutral accent strongly preferred.

*Warm, personable and confident on the phone, with a natural sales mindset.

*Tech friendly: you pick up new systems quickly and are comfortable with Google Sheets, CRMs or order management tools.

*AI enthusiast: you use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar) at work or in daily life and can give real examples.

*Good judgement: you know when AI helps and when a situation needs a human touch, and you always check AI output for accuracy.

*Organised, punctual and detail-oriented.

*Proactive and self-managing in a remote setup.

*Reliable WFH setup (fast, stable internet, quality headset, quiet space, backup power if needed).



(Bonus if you've worked with Amazon, eBay, Gumtree or other marketplaces, Odoo or a similar ERP/CRM, B2B sales, order tracking, or the furniture, events or hospitality industries. Not required!)



Why Join Us?

*Make an impact: your work directly shapes customer experience and sales growth.

*Work with AI: join a business that sees AI as a core part of how we work, with room to learn and experiment.

*Supportive team: SOPs, training and ongoing support provided, with leadership that values ideas and initiative.

*Room to grow: responsibility and variety, with opportunities to expand as the business scales.

*Flexibility: remote work during UK business hours.



How to Apply? (please read and follow all the instructions carefully)



Interested candidates should submit the following:

1. Resume

2. Cover Letter

3. Video Introduction (2-5 minutes)

4. Relevant portfolio (if applicable)



In your video, please include:

*Your name and location

*Why you're interested in the role

*A quick overview of your experience

*A snapshot of your personality and communication style

*How you'd respond to a customer asking, "When will my chairs be delivered?"

*One real example of how you've used an AI tool to do something faster or better



Please speak naturally rather than reading from a script. We want to hear you.



Use "[Your Name] - Sales & CS Specialist - 1026" as the subject of your application.



To ensure we select the most qualified candidates for our Sales & Customer Service Specialist role, please answer the following initial screening questions truthfully and completely:



1. Do you have at least 1-3 years of experience in sales or customer service roles? (yes/no)

2. Are you confident speaking with clients on the phone and converting leads into sales? (yes/no)

3. Have you handled customer enquiries by
, phone and live chat? (yes/no)

4. Can you clearly communicate with UK-based clients and customers? (yes/no)

5. Do you have a neutral or UK-accented speaking voice, or are you comfortable speaking clearly to UK customers? (yes/no)

6. Have you managed or responded to listings on Amazon, eBay, Gumtree or similar platforms? (yes/no)

7. Have you used a CRM, ERP or order management system (e.g. Odoo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho)? (yes/no) If yes, please specify:

8. Are you comfortable using Google Sheets and Google Workspace daily? (yes/no)

9. Do you regularly use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini? (yes/no) If yes, which ones and what for?

10. Have you used AI at work to improve speed or quality (e.g. drafting replies, summarising, research, reporting)? (yes/no) If yes, give one example in 2-3 sentences.

11. Are you able to follow SOPs and update them when necessary? (yes/no)

12. Do you have a reliable home working setup (stable internet, quality headset, backup power if needed)? (yes/no)

13. Are you available to work full-time during UK business hours? (yes/no)

14. Are you available to start within the next 30 days or as soon as possible? (yes/no) Please provide your earliest available start date.

15. What is your expected monthly salary (in PHP)?

We look forward to hearing from candidates who are proactive, personable, able to follow instructions clearly, and passionate about delivering an exceptional sales and customer service experience.

title: chart preparation experience in a U.S. medical practice
description:

We are specifically hiring for candidates with direct, hands-on chart preparation experience in a U.S. healthcare setting.



If you have not prepared patient charts prior to visits (including verifying referrals, authorizations, and benefits), please do not apply.







We are seeking an experienced Virtual Medical Assistant with a strong background in pre-visit chart preparation and insurance verification to support a high-volume multispecialty clinic.







This role is heavily focused on ensuring patient charts are fully prepared, verified, and complete prior to visits, including referrals, authorizations, benefits, and documentation. Candidates must have hands-on experience in chart prep workflows within a U.S. healthcare setting.







Required Experience (Applicants without this will not be considered):



Minimum 1–2 years of hands-on chart preparation experience in a U.S. medical practice

Proven experience preparing charts prior to patient intake (not just data entry or scheduling)





Experience verifying:



Referrals and authorizations

Insurance eligibility and benefits

PCP assignment and coordination of benefits

Experience using payer portals such as Availity, UHC, Tricare, Cigna, etc.

Ability to interpret and communicate patient financial responsibility before visits









Core Responsibility: Pre-Visit Chart Preparation (Primary Focus)



Prepare and audit patient charts 24–48 hours prior to appointments

Ensure completeness of:

Demographics

Active insurance

PCP assignment

Referrals & authorizations (auth #, validity, visits, POS)

Identify missing or incorrect documentation and resolve proactively

Communicate gaps to patients and clinic staff before visit date

Document all verification steps with reference numbers and notes

Insurance & Benefits Verification (Supporting Chart Prep)



Verify eligibility and benefits using portals and outbound calls

Calculate and communicate patient responsibility using fee schedules

Flag inactive coverage, COB issues, or auth requirements immediately

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a reliable, creative, and highly motivated individual to manage our daily Instagram Reels content operation. Your main responsibility will be to research viral content, recreate and edit high-quality Reels, perform face swaps where required, and independently publish the finished videos across our assigned social media accounts.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, understands social media trends, and knows how to create content that generates views, engagement, and growth.



Key Responsibilities:



- Daily Content Research: Find viral and trending Reels within our niche and identify content with high potential.



- Content Selection: Research successful creators, formats, trends, and viral video concepts.



- Video Editing: Edit and recreate Reels based on selected reference videos.



- Face Swapping: Perform realistic and high-quality face swaps when required.



- Content Optimization: Add captions, subtitles, hooks, transitions, and other necessary edits.



- Daily Publishing: Independently upload and publish the finished Reels to our assigned social media accounts.



- Account Management: Manage the daily posting process and ensure all accounts remain active.



- Performance Tracking: Monitor views, engagement, and overall content performance to continuously improve results.



Daily Requirements:



- Consistent daily research and content production.



- Regular posting across all assigned accounts.



- High-quality editing and attention to detail.



- Meeting agreed daily posting targets and deadlines.



- Staying up to date with viral trends and social media strategies.







 Compensation Structure – Performance-Based Bonus System:



**Important: This position starts with a performance-based compensation model. There is no fixed monthly salary at the beginning. Earnings are based entirely on the performance of the videos you create and publish.** 



Bonus Per Video:



- **50,000+ views:** $10 bonus

- **100,000+ views:** $15 bonus

- **150,000+ views:** $20 bonus



Bonuses are paid per qualifying video. Each video is evaluated individually based on its performance.



-Growth & Scaling Opportunities



This is a long-term opportunity with significant potential for growth.



Initially, you will start by managing a defined number of social media accounts and publishing videos daily. As performance improves and the workflow becomes more efficient, we aim to scale the operation across multiple accounts and significantly increase the number of videos published every day.



Our agency already has established  -SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), proven workflows, detailed instructions, and content strategies - designed to identify, produce, and publish viral-style videos consistently.



You will receive clear guidance and structured processes to help you understand exactly how to research, edit, face-swap, and publish content.



-Future Compensation Opportunities



As the operation grows and results remain consistent, there is an opportunity to expand the compensation structure.



For employees who demonstrate reliability, consistency, and strong performance, the agency may introduce:



- A fixed monthly salary.

- Continued performance-based bonuses on top of the fixed salary.

- Responsibility for managing additional accounts.

- Higher earning potential as the number of accounts and daily video output increases.



Our goal is to build a scalable, long-term partnership where your earning potential grows alongside the agency.**

We are looking for someone who is motivated by performance, takes ownership of their work, and wants to grow with us over the long term.



If you think you're the right fit for this position, please contact us at:

title: Crypto BD Lead: $100 Per Qualified Call + Uncapped Partnership Revenue (Player-Coach)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.

50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.

, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

title: Sales Representative
description:
# WE'RE HIRING: SALES REPRESENTATIVE – CLIENT RELATIONS

**Location:** Davao  

**Experience:** Open to entry-level and experienced applicants.



## About Us



We are an international third-party logistics (3PL) company specializing in warehousing, order fulfillment, and international shipping for e-commerce businesses worldwide.



We are looking for responsible, proactive, and highly communicative individuals to join our growing sales team. This position primarily focuses on client communication, relationship management, and sales coordination.

s and inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

Fluency in Mandarin is a significant advantage but is not mandatory for regular applicants.

Interested applicants must submit their updated résumé along with a brief introduction through the chat function of this job listing platform.

**Experience is valued. Skills are prioritized. Potential is welcome.**

title: Photography Business Acquisition Researcher – Find 10 Agencies
description:
We are an Australia-based business looking for a resourceful freelancer to identify 10 small photography agencies or established photography brands available for acquisition in the Philippines, preferably Metro Manila.



Our maximum acquisition budget is AUD $500 per business.



What We're Looking For

Small photography agencies, independent studios, or established photography brands specialising in:



- Female university students and young adults (18+).

- Lifestyle, fashion, portrait and social media photography.

- Youth-oriented photography and creative content.

- Established portfolios featuring young adult female models.



We are particularly interested in smaller businesses, independent photographers with established brands, or inactive agencies whose owners may consider selling.



What the Acquisition Should Include

Ideally, the purchase will include:

- Complete ownership of the business name and brand.

- Website, domain and social media accounts, where transferable.

- Existing photography portfolio.

- Copyright ownership or transferable commercial rights to existing photographs, including appropriate model releases.

- Existing client and model networks, subject to applicable consent and privacy requirements.

- Other relevant business and digital assets.



Important – Ongoing Collaboration

We are not looking to replace the existing owner or photographer.

Our intention is to acquire the business while offering its current owner or photographer a separate, ongoing paid contract to continue providing photography services.



This could be an attractive opportunity for small agencies or independent photographers who wish to continue their creative work without managing the business themselves.



Freelancer Deliverables

Identify 10 genuine acquisition opportunities and provide a spreadsheet containing:

1. Business or agency name and location.

2. Website and social media profiles.

3. Photography specialisation and portfolio examples.

4. Owner's name and publicly available contact details.

5. Asking price or confirmed interest in discussing a sale.

6. Assets potentially included in the acquisition.

7. Availability of transferable photo copyrights and commercial usage rights.

8. Owner's potential interest in continuing under a photography services contract.



Preferred Locations



Metro Manila is our first priority, although suitable opportunities elsewhere in the Philippines may be considered.



Who Should Apply



We welcome freelancers with experience in online research, business sourcing, photography, social media research or local business outreach.

Please briefly explain your research approach and how you would identify 10 suitable opportunities.

This is a research and sourcing assignment. No purchases, binding offers or negotiations should be made without our prior approval.



We value genuine opportunities, accurate information and confidentiality.

title: Part-time Phone Closer (US hours) – Call Florida Home-Service Owners, $4–6/hr + $40/close
description:
Part-time phone closer, US hours (9am–5pm Eastern, about 20 hrs/week to start). Pay: $4–6 per hour, plus a $40 bonus for every client you close, paid after that client's first $97 payment clears.



The job



I build simple websites for septic and other home-service businesses in Florida that do not have a website, then offer to keep the site live for them.



Your job is to call the owners, walk them through the free sample site I already built, and close them on a $97/month Website Care Plan. Month to month, 30 days' notice to cancel. No long contract.



This is phone work on warm leads. You are not writing ads, building sites, or sending cold texts. You are not starting from a raw list:



- Each owner already has a free sample site (call button, text button, quote form, their name and town).

- You get a daily ranked list of who actually opened their site, how many times, and whether they tapped call, text, or quote. Call the people who looked first, then work through the rest of the list.

- There are already 300+ owners on the list, and I am adding more.



What you are selling (say only this)



They pay $97/month for hosting on their own domain, a weekly check that the site and call/text/quote buttons still work, reviews kept current, unlimited change requests, a monthly visits/calls/quotes report, security and SSL, and a site built to current Google and AI search standards.



A real website on their own domain gives them a presence on Google and AI search. We cannot promise a #1 spot, first page of Google, or a certain number of jobs, nobody honest can, but they will be findable where they are not today. If they ask about ads or SEO, say that is not part of this plan.



Requirements



- Near-native English with minimal accent (neutral or American-sounding). We screen every applicant on the recorded pitch, and a noticeable accent is an automatic no. These are rural trade owners, and they hang up on anything that sounds like a call center.

- A reliable internet connection and a headset.

- A US VoIP number. You can use your own, or we can provide one.

- Comfortable making about 20 outbound calls an hour during the US window, logging every call, and following a script.



How to apply (read this carefully)



To show you read the post, put the word BROOKSIDE in your application subject line or the first line of your message. Applications without that word will not be reviewed.



Also include:



1. A short note about phone sales or appointment setting you have done (even a little is fine).

2. A 60-second recorded pitch (audio or video link). Pretend you are calling "Mike at Brookside Septic in Ocala." You built him a free sample site, his .com is available, and you are asking if he wants it live. Talk like a normal person. No jargon.

3. In 2–3 sentences, tell us why you're great at phone sales. What makes people stay on the line with you?

4. The hours you can actually call, your time zone, and confirmation that you can cover 9am–5pm Eastern and can use a US VoIP number (we can provide one).

title: GoHighLevel specialist to build SMS quote follow-up system for Australian roofers
description:
I run an Australian business that follows up quotes for residential roofing companies. When a roofer sends a quote and the customer doesn't respond, we reply to the customer by SMS and
 under the roofer's name, answer their questions and book a roof inspection.



I'm looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to build this as a master template (snapshot) that I can copy for each new roofing client.



The template needs to include:



1. A quote pipeline with these stages: quote sent, following up, replied, hot lead, inspection booked, won, lost, opted out.

2. A Make or Zapier connection from the roofer's job software into GoHighLevel. ServiceM8 and Jobber first, then Simpro and Fergus. A new quote should create a contact and opportunity. An accepted or declined quote should stop all follow-up.

3. A consent check. Messages only go to contacts who ticked the consent box and whose quote is less than 6 months old. Australia has strict spam laws, so this has to work reliably.

4. SMS and
 follow-up from the roofer's own Australian mobile number, which stops as soon as the customer replies.

5. Conversation AI set to suggest mode, so a person approves every reply before it is sent. Questions about price, complaints and insurance should go to the roofer instead.

6. A text to the roofer within 5 minutes when a customer shows interest, with the customer's name, number and quote.

7. An inspection booking calendar with confirmation and reminder texts.

8. Opt-out handling. A STOP reply should set the contact to DND immediately, and every message should include the business name and how to opt out.

9. A Google review request sent to every customer once their job is complete.

10. A dashboard I can use for a monthly report: quotes worked, replies, inspections booked and opt-outs.

11. Written notes and a short Loom explaining how everything works, so someone else could maintain it.



Terms:

Everything is built in my GoHighLevel account. I'll start with a paid test of 3 to 4 hours ($40 to $60). If that goes well, the template is a fixed-price job with a budget of $350 to $600, paid half when it works in testing and half when the first client is live. After that there is ongoing work at $8 to $15 an hour: setting up each new client takes about 10 to 15 hours, and each live account needs about 6 hours a month. Some overlap with Australian business hours (AEST) is needed.



Please answer these questions at the start of your application:

1. What do you need to set up to send SMS from GoHighLevel using an Australian mobile number, and what does the business need to register so its texts don't show as "Unverified"?

2. Send a Loom (under 3 minutes) of a two-way SMS workflow you have built in GoHighLevel where the sequence stops when the contact replies.

3. Have you integrated ServiceM8, Jobber, Simpro or Fergus before? Which one, and with what tool?

4. How would you set up Conversation AI so that no reply is sent without approval?

5. Your hourly rate, your fixed price for this template, and your weekly availability in December.



Applications without a Loom will not be considered.

 • 3% raise each quarter you hit your targets



Application: Create one 30-second video from the sample recipe we send. Paid trial.





Coach Wally's Sheet-Pan Salmon & Veggies



Serves 4



One pan, three colors, about 35 minutes. Simple to cook and built for the camera.



Ingredients

• 4 salmon fillets (about 6 oz / 170 g each)

• 4 cups broccoli florets

• 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes

• 3 tablespoons olive oil

• 1 large lemon, zested and juiced

• 3 garlic cloves, minced

• 1 teaspoon dried oregano

• 1 teaspoon smoked paprika

• 1 teaspoon salt

• 0.5 teaspoons black pepper



Steps

1. Preheat

    10m

    Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.

2. Make the lemon-herb mix

    In a bowl, whisk together 3 tablespoons olive oil, 1 large lemon, zested and juiced, 3 garlic cloves, minced, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon salt and 0.5 teaspoons black pepper.

3. Roast the sweet potatoes

    15m

    Toss 2 medium sweet potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes with about a third of the lemon-herb mix. Spread on the pan in a single layer and roast.

4. Add broccoli and salmon

    12m

    Toss 4 cups broccoli florets with another third of the mix. Push the sweet potatoes aside, add the broccoli, and place 4 salmon fillets (about 6 oz / 170 g each) skin-side down on the pan. Brush the salmon with the remaining mix. Roast until the salmon reaches 145°F (63°C) and flakes easily.

5. Rest and serve

    3m

    Let everything rest for a few minutes, then serve with extra lemon wedges.



Notes

Pat the salmon dry for better browning. For a plant-based version, swap the salmon for a can of chickpeas tossed with the mix and roasted with the broccoli. Use this as the sample recipe for your paid trial task.

title: Multimedia Creative Editor (Video, Photo & Motion Graphics)
description:
Loomelic Media is a Las Vegas-based creative agency producing photo, video, and social content for automotive dealerships and other U.S. businesses. We’re hiring a full-time remote Multimedia Creative Editor in the Philippines to turn footage and assets from our team into finished client work.



What you’ll do

• Edit short-form videos, including dealership reels, vehicle walkarounds, social ads, and branded content. Shape the story through pacing, music, sound, captions, and color.

• Create motion graphics, animated titles, and text callouts. Retouch photos and design graphics for social posts and campaigns.

• Adapt edits to different client brands and platform formats. Keep project files organized, check exports, and turn around revisions on schedule.

• Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, Codex, and HyperFrames where they help. We’ll train you on our workflow and cover the AI accounts required for the work.

Schedule and pay

• Full-time, 40 hours per week, during Philippine daytime hours. We’ll agree on the schedule and any meeting overlap in advance.

• $900–$1,200 USD per month for the first 90 days, depending on experience, portfolio, and demonstrated skills, plus a $50 USD monthly internet allowance. Compensation can grow after the first 90 days based on performance and responsibilities.

How to apply
