title: Car Rentals Lead Business Development Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Lead Business Development Manager to drive business growth by identifying new corporate opportunities, generating qualified leads, building relationships with prospective clients, and converting opportunities into long-term business partnerships.



This role will take ownership of the full B2B sales cycle, from data mining and prospect research to initial outreach, discovery calls, sales presentations, negotiations, and closing deals. The focus will be on engaging corporate clients with fleet rental and vehicle leasing requirements, including long-term lease arrangements, as well as other fleet-related services such as haulers and vehicle tracking solutions.



The ideal candidate is an advanced B2B sales professional who is confident initiating conversations with decision-makers, conducting discovery, presenting tailored business solutions, and negotiating commercial agreements. Familiarity with the Australian market, particularly corporate accounts and business leasing requirements, will be highly valuable.





Key Responsibilities



Lead Generation & Prospecting

Conduct data mining and market research to identify potential corporate clients, business opportunities, and target industries.

Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified prospects for vehicle leasing, fleet rentals, and related services.

Identify companies with potential long-term vehicle leasing requirements, including businesses that may require fleet arrangements for three years or longer.

Research key decision-makers, business contacts, and relevant stakeholders within target organisations.

Develop and execute outbound lead generation strategies through cold calling,
 outreach, networking, and other prospecting channels.

Proactively reach out to leads, introduce the business and its services, and generate interest in potential partnerships.

Qualify leads based on business requirements, fleet needs, budget, purchasing authority, and potential contract value.



Business Development & B2B Sales

Manage the full B2B sales cycle, from initial prospecting and lead qualification through to negotiation and closing.

Conduct introductory calls and discovery meetings to understand client requirements, business operations, fleet needs, and leasing objectives.

Build rapport and establish relationships with corporate decision-makers, procurement teams, fleet managers, and other key stakeholders.

Identify opportunities to offer tailored fleet rental, long-term leasing, hauler services, vehicle tracking, and other relevant solutions.

Develop and deliver compelling sales pitches that clearly communicate the company's services, value proposition, and competitive advantages.

Present business proposals, sales decks, pricing, and commercial solutions to prospective clients.

Handle objections, negotiate terms, and work towards securing long-term contracts and commercial agreements.

Proactively follow up with prospects throughout the sales process to maintain engagement and move opportunities towards closing.

Achieve business development objectives, sales targets, and revenue growth goals.



Discovery Calls & Sales Presentations

Lead discovery calls and client meetings to uncover business needs, fleet requirements, pain points, and purchasing considerations.

Ask relevant questions to understand the client's current fleet arrangements, vehicle utilisation, leasing preferences, and operational requirements.

Present appropriate solutions based on the client's business needs and expected fleet requirements.

Prepare and present business decks, proposals, quotations, and commercial offers.

Clearly articulate the benefits of long-term leasing arrangements and other fleet-related services.

Build compelling business cases that demonstrate value, cost efficiency, convenience, and long-term benefits to prospective clients.



Corporate & Long-Term Leasing

Identify and pursue corporate accounts with potential for long-term vehicle rental and leasing arrangements.

Develop opportunities for multi-year contracts, including leases of three years or longer.

Understand corporate fleet requirements and recommend appropriate vehicle rental or leasing arrangements.

Build relationships with corporate clients to establish recurring revenue and long-term partnerships.

Coordinate with internal teams to assess client requirements, fleet availability, pricing, and contract feasibility.

Manage commercial discussions and negotiations to secure mutually beneficial agreements.



Client Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing corporate clients.

Serve as a key point of contact throughout the sales process and client engagement.

Maintain regular communication with clients and ensure timely follow-ups.

Understand evolving client requirements and identify opportunities for additional services or account growth.

Develop opportunities for upselling and cross-selling fleet rental, long-term leasing, hauler services, vehicle tracking, and other relevant offerings.

Maintain a client-focused approach that supports retention, repeat business, and long-term commercial partnerships.



Sales Pipeline & Reporting

Maintain accurate records of leads, prospecting activities, discovery calls, proposals, negotiations, and sales opportunities.

Track and manage the sales pipeline from initial outreach through to closing.

Monitor lead conversion rates, sales activity, contract values, and business development performance.

Provide regular updates on pipeline progress, prospective clients, opportunities, challenges, and expected sales outcomes.

Identify opportunities to improve lead generation, sales conversion, and overall business development strategies.

Maintain organised CRM records and ensure sales activities and client information are updated.



Other Responsibilities

Make necessary process suggestions and improvements which can help the team.

Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.

Perform other related tasks and duties that may be assigned by the client later on.



About You

You're a highly driven and confident B2B sales professional with a strong ability to identify business opportunities, engage decision-makers, and convert prospects into long-term clients. You're comfortable initiating conversations with new prospects, conducting discovery calls, presenting business solutions, negotiating commercial terms, and closing deals.



You take ownership of the sales process, are commercially minded, and understand that successful business development requires consistent prospecting, strategic relationship-building, persistence, and the ability to communicate value. You're confident presenting to corporate clients and can build credibility with senior stakeholders.



Essential Experience and Skills

3-5+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, corporate sales, or a similar commercial role.

Proven experience managing the full sales cycle, from lead generation and prospecting through to negotiation and closing.

Strong experience in outbound sales, cold calling, lead mining, prospect research, and business development outreach.

Demonstrated ability to qualify leads, conduct discovery calls, identify client needs, and assess business opportunities.

Experience pitching products or services to corporate clients and presenting business proposals, sales decks, and commercial solutions.

Strong negotiation and closing skills, with the ability to convert qualified prospects into paying clients and long-term contracts.

Experience building relationships with business owners, senior decision-makers, procurement teams, and corporate stakeholders.

Ability to develop and manage a sales pipeline, track opportunities, and maintain accurate CRM records.

Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to understand client requirements and position solutions based on value, business needs, and ROI.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence in conducting professional business calls, meetings, and presentations.

Highly proactive, persistent, and results-oriented, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of sales targets and business development initiatives.



Nice to Have

Experience in the Australian market, particularly working with Australian businesses and corporate decision-makers.

Previous experience in vehicle leasing, car rental, fleet management, automotive, transport, logistics, or mobility services.

Experience securing long-term corporate leasing or rental agreements, including multi-year contracts.

Familiarity with fleet-related services such as vehicle tracking, hauler services, fleet solutions, or commercial vehicle leasing.

Experience selling high-value services, recurring contracts, or complex B2B solutions.

Existing network of corporate contacts or experience developing relationships within the Australian business market.

Familiarity with CRM platforms and sales tools for lead mining, prospecting, pipeline management, and sales reporting.



Personal Attributes

Confident and persuasive communicator who can build credibility with corporate clients.

Highly proactive and comfortable initiating conversations and conducting cold outreach.

Strong commercial mindset with a focus on revenue generation and closing deals.

Strategic and consultative, with the ability to understand client needs before presenting solutions.

Resilient and persistent, particularly when handling objections and navigating lengthy sales cycles.

Relationship-oriented, with the ability to build trust and maintain long-term client partnerships.

Results-driven, accountable, and motivated by achieving sales targets.

Adaptable and resourceful, with the ability to identify opportunities and navigate changing client requirements.





Finer Details

Schedule: TBD

Start Date:

TO BE AMENDED

title: Creative Sales Funnel Strategist & Course Designer
description:

s - aimed at our clientele who are mostly stay-at-home mothers with children of all ages.

s they receive, the course they log into, and the materials they download.

s.

- Make the course attractive, organized, and easy for participants to navigate.



4. Thirty Daily Challenge
s



- Design one beautiful, reusable branded
 template.

- Format and set up 30 daily challenge
s using copy supplied by us.

- Include attractive headings, graphics, buttons, and links.

- Schedule and automate the
s correctly.

- Test
 formatting and functionality.



5. Affiliate & Promotional Graphics



- Create a coordinated promotional graphics kit for affiliates.

- Design four square social media graphics, four vertical story graphics, two
 banners, and two additional promotional graphics.

- Provide editable Canva templates for future use.

- Maintain consistent branding across all materials.



6. Worksheets & Downloadable Materials



- Design and format up to ten worksheets, checklists, or downloadable resources using content supplied by us.

- Create consistent, attractive layouts suitable for printing or digital use.

- Supply final PDFs and editable source files.



7. Testing & Final Delivery



- Test the entire registration and course-access experience.

- Check
 automations, links, and checkout functionality.

- Ensure designs are mobile-responsive.

- Include up to two rounds of consolidated revisions per deliverable group.

- Provide all editable design files, Canva templates, and final graphics.

- Provide brief handover instructions.



We will supply:



- All 30 daily
 texts.

- Educational content for worksheets and handouts.

- Course videos and lesson content as they become available.

- Program details, pricing, schedule, and speaker information.

- Existing business branding and creative direction.

- Access to the necessary platforms.



You will be responsible for the visual design, creative development, implementation, and technical setup.



We welcome creative suggestions for improving the sales page, messaging, customer experience, and overall program design.



Required Skills



- Marketing Funnel Strategy: Strong understanding of how to plan and structure effective sales funnels that guide potential customers from initial interest to purchase.

- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Ability to strategically structure sales pages, position calls to action, address customer objections, and improve conversion opportunities.

- Customer Journey &
 Marketing Strategy: Understanding of how landing pages, lead capture,
 nurture sequences, checkout pages, and follow-up automations work together to convert prospects into paying customers.

- Creative Direction & Branding: Excellent graphic design skills, strong aesthetic judgment, and the ability to develop cohesive, sophisticated visual branding.

- Sales Funnel Design & Implementation: Proven experience independently planning, designing, and building complete sales funnels — not simply implementing someone else's instructions.

- Kajabi: Experience building landing pages, setting up courses, configuring checkout processes, and implementing
 automations.

- Graphic Design: Strong Canva skills; Figma or Adobe experience is a plus.

- Marketing Psychology: Understanding of persuasive messaging, customer motivations, emotional triggers, and effective visual storytelling.

-
 & Promotional Design: Experience creating attractive, strategically designed marketing
s, promotional graphics, and branded digital materials.

- Independent Thinking: Ability to recommend marketing strategies, suggest improvements, and make informed creative decisions without requiring detailed instructions.

- Communication & Project Management: Strong written English, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage a complete project from concept through launch.



Timeline

Our challenge begins in January.

We need someone who can begin immediately, prioritize the sales funnel so registration and promotion can begin as soon as possible, and complete the remaining deliverables before the challenge launches.



Please confirm your availability and provide a realistic project schedule.



How to Apply

Please send:



1. Links to three complete funnels or digital product launches you've personally worked on.

2. Examples of your best sales page and graphic design work.

3. Examples of course dashboards, lesson thumbnails,
 designs, or promotional graphics.

4. Your estimated completion timeline.

5. A brief description of which parts of your previous projects you designed independently versus implemented from instructions.

6. Creative Inspiration Board (Required) - please submit a one-page visual inspiration board (mood board) showing the branding direction you would recommend for this challenge.



**Important:** Please include the words "Creative 30-Day Challenge Launch" at the beginning of your application so we know you've read the full description.



We will shortlist candidates based on portfolio quality, relevant experience, creative thinking, and technical skills. Finalists may be invited to complete a small paid design test.

title: Technical Solutions Lead — Measurement, Data And AI (part-time)
description:
US hours, night shift



DeltaSmith is looking for a senior technical problem-solver who designs, builds and checks reliable measurement and data solutions.



You will work across Google Tag Manager, GA4, PostHog, consent tools, data integrations and AI coding assistants, and you will own technical quality for our client work alongside the account manager.



The work: diagnose and simplify technical issues; build fixes or hand them off; check what AI assistants produce; test tracking and data quality; approve releases on evidence; build reusable checklists and monitoring.



What we look for: measurement and tracking experience, JavaScript and integration debugging, consent and privacy in practice, ownership of quality, strong habits with AI assistants, clear writing, and a preference for simple solutions that last.



Arrangement: part-time contractor, starting at 10 hours a week and growing with the work. At least four hours a day inside 09:00–17:00 Bogotá. A small paid trial project comes first, then a two-week paid pilot.



Process: five short questions, then a small paid trial project, then a two-week paid pilot.



Please answer these five questions in your first message:

1. Measurement. GA4 reports about twice as many leads as the CRM. How would you investigate before changing anything?

2. Simplicity. Describe a real solution you simplified, replaced with a setting, or deleted. What was there, what did you change, and why?

3. AI assistants. How do you use AI tools when building or debugging? Give one example where the AI's output was wrong or far too complicated, and how you caught it.

4. Accountability. You are asked to approve a consent change that worked in the developer's tests, but the evidence is incomplete. What do you need before you sign off?

5. Availability and experience. Your weekly hours and your four-hour overlap with 09:00–17:00 Bogotá, and a short summary of your hands-on work with Google Tag Manager, GA4, PostHog, consent tools and JavaScript.

Fully Remote | Long-term Contractor | ~40 hrs/week | $4 to $20 USD/hour + up to $525 bonus per video



About Us

We sell unique, personalized jewelry, gifts and travel products online. Your work is judged on one thing: does the ad sell. Your videos run for real products with real ad spend behind them. Many of our team members have been with us 2+ years.



Pay

The pay range for this role is listed below. It covers your total earnings: your hourly base pay plus the bonuses you earn on winning ads.

- Total pay: $4 to $20 USD/hour, plus up to $525 per video in bonuses and a weekly bonus

- Base: set by your experience, then reviewed after 4 to 6 weeks and raised as your ads win

- Bonuses: paid on top, based on how much ad spend your videos get

- Growth path: everyone can grow to $20/hour. Top performers can also move up to help lead other editors.



What You'll Do

- Edit short video ads for TikTok, Reels and Meta in many styles: AI videos, animation, AI songs, talking heads and trends

- Edit mostly in vertical 9:16 for feeds and stories

- Take a reference ad and rebuild its structure for our products

- Make new versions of winning ads: new hooks, openings and voiceovers, same structure

- Use AI tools to help write and create videos

- Share a quick daily update with the team



Who This Is For

- You've edited short videos or ads (show us the videos)

- Must be comfortable in CapCut, which is where you'll edit every ad

- Strong sense of hooks and pacing: the first seconds d
 if people keep watching

- A good eye for detail, so products look like the real thing, and good written English



Nice to Have

- AI video, voice or image tools (we'll train you)

- Experience making ads for online stores



Working Style

- Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

- Location: 100% remote, set your own hours

- Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role



Sound like a fit? Apply with links to short videos or ads you've edited.

title: Senior B2B Cold Calling Superstar – Lead Generation
description:
Are you a natural sales hunter who loves cold calling, getting past gatekeepers and booking appointments? We want YOU!



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9am–5pm Perth, Australia Time



QPC Group is an award-winning Australian office technology company, established in 2008.



We're looking for an experienced B2B cold-calling specialist who knows how to turn complete strangers into genuine sales opportunities.



This is a pure outbound lead generation role. Your job is to find opportunities and book qualified appointments — our Australian sales team handles the selling and closing.



What You'll Be Doing



Cold calling Australian businesses using supplied prospect lists and our existing database.



Researching companies, finding decision-makers and confidently getting past gatekeepers.



Building rapport, asking great questions and uncovering business pain points.



Handling objections and turning conversations into qualified sales appointments.



Following up with prospects and keeping accurate CRM records.



Your calling activity will consist of approximately:



60% Cold Calling – Prospecting businesses and generating new opportunities.



30% Warm Database – Reconnecting with existing contacts and identifying opportunities.



10% Supplied Leads – Following up on leads provided by QPC Group.



We provide prospect lists, but you must know how to research businesses, identify the right contacts and reach decision-makers.



Who We're Looking For



You MUST have:



5+ years of proven B2B outbound cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.



Excellent spoken English and a natural, confident telephone manner.



Proven ability to get past gatekeepers, handle objections and reach decision-makers.



Strong prospecting and LinkedIn research skills.



A track record of consistently achieving appointment targets.



We're looking for someone persistent, resilient, self-motivated and genuinely passionate about hunting for new business.



No robotic script readers! We want someone who can have real conversations, build rapport and think on their feet.



Experience in IT, telecommunications, printers, photocopiers or other B2B technology solutions is a bonus.



What Success Looks Like



Our target is a minimum of 30 qualified sales appointments per month.



You must be comfortable with high-volume outbound calling, sometimes making 100+ calls per day.



However, we value quality over quantity. A day with 40 calls and several meaningful conversations can be more productive than 100 unanswered calls.



We measure success by genuine opportunities and qualified appointments, not just how many numbers you dial.



Working Hours



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9am–5pm Perth, Western Australia Time



You must have a quiet working environment, reliable internet and backup arrangements for power or internet outages.



How to Apply – Please Read Carefully!



Minimum Apply Points: 3



You must use at least 3 Apply Points when submitting your application through OnlineJobs.ph.



Mandatory Subject Line: Outbound Sales Genius



Please include ALL of the following:



Your CV – Highlight your B2B outbound cold-calling and appointment-setting experience.



Your Sales Results – Tell us your average calls per day, qualified appointments booked per month and targets achieved.



Voice Recording (Mandatory) – Send us a 30-second recording of your best cold-call opening to an Australian business owner about their office printers or photocopiers. We want to hear your confidence, personality and natural conversational skills. Please don't just read a script!



Your DISC Profile (Mandatory) – Include a copy of your DISC personality assessment results.



Working Hours – Confirm you can work Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm Perth, Western Australia time.



Please provide three genuine professional references.



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Contacting QPC Group outside this platform will disqualify your application.



Ready to Join Us?



If you're a proven sales hunter who loves the challenge of cold calling, getting past gatekeepers and turning a "not interested" into a qualified appointment, we'd love to hear from you!



We're looking for someone who doesn't just make calls — they make things happen!

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
Hiring: Video Editing Virtual Assistant (Remote)



Part-Time | Flexible Hours | Ongoing Work



We are looking for a reliable Video Editing Virtual Assistant to help turn raw talking-to-camera footage into short, professional Instagram Reels and Stories.



**This is a basic editing role. We are NOT looking for advanced video editing, fancy effects or complicated transitions.**



We already have a simple process using the **Captions App**. We just need someone who can follow it consistently and produce clean, professional videos.



### What You'll Be Doing



You will receive approximately **3 minutes of raw video footage**, which needs to be edited into a finished video of approximately **60 seconds**.



Most videos feature one person speaking directly to the camera about business, property and entrepreneurship.



### Step 1 – Clean Up the Video



Upload the raw footage into the Captions App.



Use the AI editing tools to:



- Remove filler words (um, ah, etc.).

- Remove unnecessary pauses and gaps.

- Remove mistakes, repeated sentences and false starts.

- Create one continuous, natural-flowing video.

- Reduce the footage to approximately 60 seconds.

- Keep the original message and important information intact.



**Quality check:** Watch the entire edited video to ensure it sounds natural, makes sense and has no awkward cuts.



### Step 2 – Add Captions & Visuals



Using the Captions App:



- Add clear, accurate subtitles.

- Position captions towards the bottom of the screen without covering the speaker.

- Keep caption styles consistent across videos.

- Occasionally add relevant B-roll footage or pictures where they help illustrate what is being discussed.

- Avoid unnecessary animations, effects or distracting edits.



### Step 3 – Final Quality Check & Export



Before submitting:



- Watch the finished video from start to finish.

- Check spelling, punctuation and subtitle timing.

- Ensure the audio and video flow naturally.

- Confirm the captions are correctly positioned.

- Export in vertical **9:16 format (1080 × 1920)**, suitable for Instagram Reels and Stories.

- Save the completed video to our shared folder.



### What We're Looking For



- Experience using Captions App or similar AI editing software.

- Basic video editing skills.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Ability to follow clear instructions.

- Reliable turnaround times.

- Someone interested in consistent, ongoing work.



### What We Offer



- Remote working.

- Flexible hours.

- Straightforward, repeatable tasks.

- Regular video editing work.

- Opportunity for a long-term working relationship.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience with Captions App or similar tools.

3. Examples of short-form videos you've edited.

4. Your expected rate per completed 60-second video.

5. Your typical turnaround time per video.



**Please start your application with the words "VIDEO EDITOR" so we know you've read the full advert.**



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a short, paid trial edit.

title: Remote Accounts Receivable
description:
# Accounts Receivable Specialist (m/f/d) – Remote



**Department:** Finance & Accounting

**Location:** Remote

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Company:** IronMaxx Nutrition GmbH



## About IronMaxx



IronMaxx is a fast-growing European sports nutrition brand, developing and distributing innovative products across e-commerce, retail, marketplaces, and international markets.



As our business continues to expand, we are strengthening our Finance & Accounting team and looking for a reliable, detail-oriented **Accounts Receivable Specialist** to support our daily financial operations remotely.



## Your Responsibilities



**Accounts Receivable & Payment Management**

- Manage day-to-day accounts receivable activities, ensuring accurate and timely processing of customer payments.

- Monitor outstanding receivables, track overdue invoices, and follow up on payment discrepancies.

- Reconcile incoming payments with open customer invoices and accounts.

- Maintain accurate customer account balances and resolve inconsistencies.



**Collections & Claims Management**

- Support the dunning and collections process, including payment reminders and overdue account follow-ups.

- Investigate payment differences, deductions, credit notes, and disputed invoices.

- Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, and Finance to resolve outstanding claims.

- Maintain transparent documentation of open receivables and their resolution status.



**Accounting & Reporting**

- Record and reconcile accounts receivable transactions in our ERP system (SAP Business One).

- Assist with month-end closing activities and accounts receivable reconciliations.

- Prepare aging reports, outstanding balance overviews, and other financial analyses.

- Identify opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and automation within AR processes.



## Your Profile



- Completed education or degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

- At least 2–3 years of professional experience in Accounts Receivable, Finance Operations, or General Accounting.

- Strong understanding of invoice processing, payment reconciliation, collections, and customer account management.

- Experience working with ERP/accounting systems; **SAP Business One is a strong advantage**.

- Excellent Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets.

- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines.

- Proactive approach to identifying and resolving financial discrepancies.

- Comfortable working independently and communicating effectively in a remote environment.

- **Good English communication skills; German is a strong advantage**, particularly for DACH customer correspondence.



## What We Offer



- Remote working arrangement with an international, collaborative team.

- Opportunity to contribute to a growing European consumer brand.

- Exposure to multiple sales channels, including B2B, retail, e-commerce, and marketplaces.

- A dynamic environment with ownership of operational accounting activities.

- Opportunities to improve processes, implement automation, and grow professionally.

- Structured onboarding and close collaboration with our Finance team in Germany.



## What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, you will:



- Take ownership of assigned customer accounts and daily AR activities.

- Ensure consistent monitoring and accurate reconciliation of incoming payments.

- Establish clear visibility of overdue balances and unresolved payment discrepancies.

- Support timely month-end closing and reliable AR reporting.

- Identify at least one opportunity to improve an existing accounts receivable process.



**Ready to #BEcomeMAXX?**



Join IronMaxx and help us build scalable, reliable financial processes that support our international growth.

title: # Senior SEO Specialist – Australian Digital Marketing Agency
description:
**Location:** Philippines (Remote)  

**Employment:** Full-time  

**Working hours:** 40 hours per week  

**Salary:** ₱50,000–₱65,000 per month, negotiable depending on experience



## About the position



We are an established Australian digital marketing agency managing websites and digital marketing campaigns for clients across Australia and New Zealand.



We're looking for an experienced, hands-on SEO specialist to take responsibility for the organic search performance of multiple client websites.



This is not an entry-level SEO assistant position. We need someone who understands SEO thoroughly, pays attention to detail and can work independently without constant supervision.



You will be responsible for implementing, monitoring and improving SEO across an existing portfolio of client websites, as well as working on new websites as they are developed.



## Your responsibilities



- Conduct comprehensive SEO audits and identify technical and on-page issues.

- Implement on-page SEO improvements across WordPress websites.

- Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.

- Optimise page titles, meta descriptions, headings, content and internal links.

- Manage technical SEO, including indexing, crawlability, redirects, canonical tags and XML sitemaps.

- Implement and validate schema markup and structured data.

- Manage Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.

- Develop local SEO strategies, including Google Business Profile optimisation.

- Identify content opportunities and recommend improvements to existing pages.

- Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic and conversions.

- Prepare meaningful monthly reports showing work completed and results achieved.

- Identify and resolve SEO problems before they affect client performance.

- Previous experience managing multiple client websites.

- Strong WordPress SEO experience.

- Excellent understanding of technical and on-page SEO.

- Experience with Google Search Console and GA4.

- Excellent written English.

We want someone who takes ownership of their work.

We don't want someone who simply follows a checklist without understanding what they're doing.



Attention to detail is extremely important. Missing basic SEO requirements, overlooking technical problems or implementing changes without checking the results is not acceptable.



You should be comfortable working independently, managing your workload and communicating clearly about progress and any issues you identify.



Experience working with Australian businesses or digital marketing agencies would be an advantage.



## What we offer



- Full-time, long-term employment.

- Competitive salary based on experience and ability.

- Opportunity to work with an established Australian digital marketing agency.

- A varied workload involving multiple websites and SEO challenges.

- A stable working relationship with an experienced team.



## How to apply



Please provide the following information with your application:



1. A summary of your SEO experience and the types of websites you've managed.

2. Examples of websites where you've personally undertaken SEO work.

3. Your experience with technical SEO audits and WordPress.

4. The SEO tools you use regularly.

5. Examples of technical SEO problems you've identified and resolved.

6. Your expected monthly salary.

7. Your availability to commence full-time employment.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a practical SEO assessment.

## Ready to #BEcomeMAXX?



If you're a detail-oriented accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership, solving discrepancies, and contributing to reliable financial operations, we want to hear from you.



**Apply now and become part of IronMaxx!**

title: E-Commerce Sales Rep
description:
Look, let’s keep this super real so nobody wastes their time.



We’re scaling fast in the e-commerce space and looking for a seriously hungry sales rep who actually wants to make money. This isn't one of those chill "admin" or "customer support" VA gigs where you hide behind spreadsheets all day.



Here is the exact day-to-day reality of this job:



It is 100% pure sales. You’ll be doing outbound outreach (cold/warm calls, DMs,
s), following up with leads, handling objections, and closing deals every single day.



You are going to hear "no" a lot. You need thick skin, high energy, and the drive to keep dialing and messaging without someone babysitting you.



Zero busywork. Your only focus is building pipeline and closing revenue.

title: Proven E-Commerce Sales Closer ($5/hr + Commission – Must Show Track Record)
description:
This $5/hr seat is not for beginners or people "trying out" sales. We’re looking for a legitimate closer who knows e-commerce inside and out and can prove they know how to sell.



To be completely upfront about what you’re walking into: this is a daily, high-output sales grind. You’ll be doing outbound prospecting, working leads, pitching over calls and messages, handling tough objections on the spot, and closing deals. No admin fluff, no social media management—just pure revenue generation.



What it takes to land the $5/hr rate:



Deep sales knowledge: You know how to structure a pitch, uncover pain points, handle objections without folding, and ask for the close cleanly.



E-Commerce expertise: You understand how e-commerce businesses operate, move product, and scale—so you can hold your own in real business conversations.

_____________________________________________________________________________________



Red Kyren Studios is a creative studio in Los Angeles and Manila. I'm bringing on one freelance video editor for client work.

title: Outbound Sales Representative (Cold Calling & Closing)
description:
Outbound Sales Representative – Cold Calling & Closing

Starting salary: ₱45,000 per month

Work setup: Full-time | Work from home | Philippines-based applicants

Schedule: U.S. business hours



We’re hiring an Outbound Sales Representative to support a U.S.-based business. You must have experience making high-volume cold calls for a U.S.-based business and personally guiding interested prospects through a completed sale or sign-up.



You’ll introduce a straightforward service, determine interest, and walk prospects through sign-up. We’ll provide training, a call script, and step-by-step procedures. If you enjoy meeting new people, like the challenge of earning someone’s interest, and feel comfortable asking for the sale, this role could be a great fit.



Key Responsibilities

- Open each call confidently, explain why you’re calling, and ask focused questions to determine interest and fit.

- Listen closely, answer routine questions in your own words, and handle objections professionally.

- Recognize when a prospect is ready, ask for the sale, and guide them through the authorization needed to complete sign-up.

- Record the outcome, schedule a follow-up when appropriate, and move promptly to the next call.

Requirements

- Excellent spoken English, with clear pronunciation and natural pacing. You can follow a script and keep the conversation flowing when a prospect asks an unexpected question.

- An outgoing, persuasive phone presence and the resilience to bring the same energy to the next call after hearing “no.”

- Comfortable using an outbound dialer or softphone, recording call outcomes, and learning a new system.

- Outbound sales experience in financial services is preferred. Experience speaking with customers in New York or the Tri-State area is a plus.

Growth Opportunity



As the Philippines-based sales team grows, a strong performer may have the opportunity to train new hires and advance into a Team Leader role.



To Apply



Briefly describe your most recent outbound sales role. What did you sell, roughly how many calls did you make per day, and what counted as a completed sale? Include one sales target or result you personally achieved.



Skill Requirements: Cold Calling · Outbound Sales · Telemarketing

title: AI Video Editor and Producer (Animation and Sound), Long-Term
description:

ABOUT MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and build our own products.



We have delivered a lot of client projects we are proud of, and we want to show them. That's where you come in.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



THE ROLE



Most of your time goes to creating video case studies of our client projects. We give you the story behind each project, and you turn it into a short video people want to watch.



You do this the AI way. You combine animation, AI-generated video and AI voice and sound into one polished piece. And when AI can't get a shot or a cut right, you open your editing software and fix it by hand.



LOCATION AND TIME:



- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 3:00 p.m - 12:00 a.m Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Create video case studies of our client projects, from script to final edit

- Make animations with Claude Motion

- Create AI-generated video with tools like Higgsfield, or 3D animation in Blender

- Produce voice-overs and sound with ElevenLabs, and make sure the audio is clean and well mixed

- Build a growing library of client story videos



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must-have:

- A portfolio of videos you made yourself

- Hands-on experience with AI video, animation or motion tools

- Solid sound skills: voice-overs, music, mixing and clean audio

- An eye for storytelling, so a technical project becomes a story people understand

- Good written and spoken English



Nice-to-have:

- Strong traditional video editing skills in tools like Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or After Effects, so you can step in by hand where AI falls short. This is a big plus

- Experience with Claude Motion, Higgsfield, Blender or ElevenLabs

- Motion graphics or 3D experience

- Experience making videos for B2B or tech companies

- Interest in AI and software



WHAT WE OFFER



- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and room to grow

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with the latest AI tools as part of your daily work

- Freedom to propose: new ideas and formats are welcome

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



HOW TO APPLY:



Send the following to 



1. Links to 2 or 3 videos you made, with or without AI. Add a short note on each saying which tools you used and what you did yourself

2. Your CV

3. A few sentences on why this role fits you



 subject: "AI Video Editor Application - [Your Name]"



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review your portfolio and CV

2. Strong matches get an initial interview

3. Final candidates may get a short practical assignment



WHO SHOULD APPLY:



Apply if you:

- Love making videos and enjoy trying new AI tools

- Care about quality, down to the sound

- Want a long-term career, not a short-term gig



Don't apply if you:

- Can't share a portfolio of your own work

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients



We look forward to seeing your work.



MSTR,

title: EA/CEO Execution Partner / Personal Operations Manager
description:
EA/CEO Execution Partner / Personal Operations Manager

Protect the Founder’s Time. Let Founder do what they're best at.

Remote, Philippines | U.S. Eastern overlap | Full-time

50 hours per week



Compensation and Validation

$2,500/month during the first 90-day validation period

First 14 days are a paid work trial using real work

Operators who far exceed the agreed performance standard move to a $3,500/month base on Day 90, with additional upside as impact and ownership expand. 

Performance is reviewed weekly. Compensation and scope are formally reviewed at Day 90

This is not pay for activity.



You do not earn more by being online, maintaining a task list, or sending pleasant updates. You earn more by finishing meaningful work, protecting CEO's time, solving problems without being chased, and permanently removing work from his plate.



The Day 90 review will consider:

Meaningful work completed

Founder time and attention saved

Recurring responsibilities removed from CEO

Follow-ups eliminated

Blockers solved without founder intervention

Health, personal, and CEO priorities moved forward

Problems converted into delegation, automation, systems, or deletion

Whether CEO had to chase, remind, or re-explain work

If you exceed the agreed standard, your base increases to $3,500/month beginning with the next pay period. Exceptional performance can earn additional upside and expanded ownership.

There will be no surprise standards introduced at Day 90.



This role is for a rare kind of person

You see unfinished work and feel compelled to finish it.

You do not need a founder to explain every obvious next step.

You get genuine satisfaction from taking chaos, pressure, loose ends, and half-formed ideas and turning them into:

“Done. Here’s what changed.”

You are not looking for a job where you wait for instructions and keep a task list updated.

You want to become the person who makes an overloaded founder dramatically lighter.



Why this role exists

Ceo is a visionary.

His highest-value work is thinking, creating, d
, leading, and building the future.

His weakness is that once ideas leave his head, a mountain of execution follows:

Health tasks

Appointments

Records

Research

Follow-ups

Travel

Personal logistics

Errands

Vendors

Scheduling

Projects

Loose ends

When those things remain unfinished, they return to Dylan’s brain. He becomes the reminder system, scheduler, researcher, project manager, and emergency backup.

That steals his time, energy, health, focus, and ability to be fully himself.

Your job is to remove that burden.

Not organize it.

Not report on it.

Finish it.

Your mission

You are the execution engine behind Ceo’s vision.

You will take messy voice notes, ideas, priorities, and unfinished work and turn them into completed outcomes without requiring Ceo to project-manage the middle.



You will:

Clarify the desired outcome.

Identify the next actions.

Own or coordinate the execution.

Push through blockers.

Close the loop with proof.

Prevent the same problem from returning.

Your goal is for Ceo to spend more of his life being authentic by doing only what he should do. 

Thinking

Creating

D

Leading

Building the future

You handle the mountain of execution that allows him to stay in that role.



What you will own

Finish a large volume of meaningful work from Ceo’s active to-do list every day

Protect his calendar, deep work, recovery, health, and personal priorities

Drive health administration from approved decision to completion

Schedule appointments, gather records, prepare documents, and close follow-ups

Turn voice notes and ideas into prioritized action and completed projects

Own travel, Trip preparation, errands, purchases, vendors, reservations, and personal logistics

Chase people, enforce deadlines, remove blockers, and find another route when the first route fails

Keep open loops visible and moving

Identify recurring friction and eliminate it through delegation, automation, systemization, or deletion

Give concise updates containing what finished, what changed, what is blocked, your recommendation, and the next date

Protect team from being diverted into Ceo's personal and CEO-level execution work

You do not make medical, relationship, values, or major financial decisions. You own the execution around those decisions and escalate only what truly requires the CEO.

Health-related information must be handled only through approved, privacy-compliant systems and workflows.



What a great day looks like

At the beginning of the day, you know:

What CEO wants moved

What matters most

What can be handled without him

What needs clarification

What must be finished today

During the day, you move mountains:

Close open loops

Push delayed people

Complete health and personal tasks

Convert ideas into action

Remove friction

Protect CEOs time

Solve problems before they reach him

At the end of the day, CEO should not be asking, “What happened with that?”

He should be able to see:

What finished. What changed. What is blocked. What you are handling next.



What winning looks like

After 7 days

CEO feels significantly lighter. Important things are moving. He is no longer reminding you what happens next. You have completed real health, personal, and execution work. You have shown that you can take ownership without being chased. CEO  is no longer carrying routine personal work, chasing follow-ups, or remembering unfinished details. You are independently running your lane.



After 14 days

Can send a messy voice note and trust that it will become organized, prioritized, and executed without him pushing every step.

The highest compliment you can receive is:

“I forgot that was even a problem.”

You become deeply trusted because the CEO's life and priorities move reliably without him carrying the execution.



This is not for you if

You need instructions for every step

You say “I’m on it” instead of producing results

You wait passively when someone is slow

You get stuck because another person has not replied

You avoid uncomfortable follow-ups

You need praise or reassurance to keep moving

You confuse activity with progress

You send summaries instead of completed outcomes

You become defensive when corrected

You want a relaxed, low-pressure assistant job

You are juggling multiple full-time clients

You want to manage people before proving you can execute personally

You change jobs every few months and blame every company for the pattern



This is for you if

You are a finisher

You stay calm when things are messy

You move quickly without becoming careless

You push professionally without needing formal authority

You ask sharp questions, then act

You naturally protect the person you support from friction

You have taken unclear work from start to completion

You can handle personal, administrative, logistical, and business-adjacent work without ego

You prefer being judged by outcomes instead of hours

You want a long-term seat where trust, autonomy, and compensation grow with impact

You get satisfaction from making difficult things disappear

We do not need someone to manage a tracker.

We need someone who makes the tracker unnecessary.



The standard

You are not paid to maintain a to-do list.

You are paid to empty it.

If CEO has to chase you, remind you, investigate your work, or repeatedly explain the same expectation, the role is failing.

If you naturally say:

“I saw it. I handled it. Here’s the proof.”

you may be exactly who we are looking for.



What you get if you win

Direct access to the CEO

Real ownership over a high-trust execution lane

Increasing autonomy as you prove reliability

Compensation growth tied to real impact

The opportunity to become exceptional at founder-level execution

The chance to build systems and judgment that prepare you for larger operating responsibility

A role where your work directly improves another person’s health, freedom, focus, and output

This is not a role where you disappear into a department.

When you do your job well, the founder thinks more clearly, creates more, makes better decisions, and gets his life back.

That is your scoreboard.



How to apply

Do not use quick apply.

Begin your message with Dear DUC.

Send all six items:

Your résumé or LinkedIn profile.

A two-minute video describing the messiest problem you personally drove from unclear to completed.

One example of pushing someone senior or unresponsive to get something finished.

One artifact from prior work showing something you built or completed. This can be a process, project, checklist, before-and-after example, or other proof. Remove confidential information.



Answer this scenario in 5–8 bullets:

CEO sends you a voice note containing five unfinished health and personal tasks. What do you do in the next 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 7 days?

Your preferred compensation and earliest start date.

Missing information, generic answers, or quick-apply submissions will be rejected.

Finalists complete a paid 14-day work trial using real work.

We do not hire based on charm, confidence, or polished résumés.

We hire based on proof.

If you want to be told what to do, do not apply.

If you want to become the person who makes a founder breathe easier because nothing important gets dropped, apply.



If you read this and think:

“Finally. A role where finishing hard things is the whole point.”

we want to hear from you.

What finished. What changed. What is blocked. What you are handling next.



What winning looks like

After 7 days

CEO feels significantly lighter. Important things are moving. He is no longer reminding you what happens next. You have completed real health, personal, and execution work. You have shown that you can take ownership without being chased. CEO  is no longer carrying routine personal work, chasing follow-ups, or remembering unfinished details. You are independently running your lane.



After 14 days

Can send a messy voice note and trust that it will become organized, prioritized, and executed without him pushing every step.

The highest compliment you can receive is:

“I forgot that was even a problem.”

You become deeply trusted because the CEO's life and priorities move reliably without him carrying the execution.



This is not for you if

You need instructions for every step

You say “I’m on it” instead of producing results

You wait passively when someone is slow

You get stuck because another person has not replied

You avoid uncomfortable follow-ups

You need praise or reassurance to keep moving

You confuse activity with progress

You send summaries instead of completed outcomes

You become defensive when corrected

You want a relaxed, low-pressure assistant job

You are juggling multiple full-time clients

You want to manage people before proving you can execute personally

You change jobs every few months and blame every company for the pattern



This is for you if

You are a finisher

You stay calm when things are messy

You move quickly without becoming careless

You push professionally without needing formal authority

You ask sharp questions, then act

You naturally protect the person you support from friction

You have taken unclear work from start to completion

You can handle personal, administrative, logistical, and business-adjacent work without ego

You prefer being judged by outcomes instead of hours

You want a long-term seat where trust, autonomy, and compensation grow with impact

You get satisfaction from making difficult things disappear

We do not need someone to manage a tracker.

We need someone who makes the tracker unnecessary.



The standard

You are not paid to maintain a to-do list.

You are paid to empty it.

If CEO has to chase you, remind you, investigate your work, or repeatedly explain the same expectation, the role is failing.

If you naturally say:

“I saw it. I handled it. Here’s the proof.”

you may be exactly who we are looking for.



What you get if you win

Direct access to the CEO

Real ownership over a high-trust execution lane

Increasing autonomy as you prove reliability

Compensation growth tied to real impact

The opportunity to become exceptional at founder-level execution

The chance to build systems and judgment that prepare you for larger operating responsibility

A role where your work directly improves another person’s health, freedom, focus, and output

This is not a role where you disappear into a department.

When you do your job well, the founder thinks more clearly, creates more, makes better decisions, and gets his life back.

That is your scoreboard.



How to apply

Do not use quick apply.

Begin your message with Dear DUC.

Send all six items:

Your résumé or LinkedIn profile.

A two-minute video describing the messiest problem you personally drove from unclear to completed.

One example of pushing someone senior or unresponsive to get something finished.

One artifact from prior work showing something you built or completed. This can be a process, project, checklist, before-and-after example, or other proof. Remove confidential information.



Answer this scenario in 5–8 bullets:

CEO sends you a voice note containing five unfinished health and personal tasks. What do you do in the next 30 minutes, 24 hours, and 7 days?

Your preferred compensation and earliest start date.

Missing information, generic answers, or quick-apply submissions will be rejected.

Finalists complete a paid 14-day work trial using real work.

We do not hire based on charm, confidence, or polished résumés.

We hire based on proof.

If you want to be told what to do, do not apply.

If you want to become the person who makes a founder breathe easier because nothing important gets dropped, apply.



If you read this and think:

“Finally. A role where finishing hard things is the whole point.”

we want to hear from you.

title: Operations & Project Manager (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company



Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers.



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before.

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up:

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing.

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners.



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply.



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership.



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level.

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no random meetings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to.

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit.



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test) Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:



Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove from messy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.”

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4: Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.

In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.”

Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



Link the Google Doc here (view access).



Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

title: Client Outreach Caller - US Medicaid Home Care (Part-Time, Long-Term) - $5/hr + Bonuses
description:
Optimal Care LLC is a growing home care agency in North Dakota, USA. We help people on Medicaid get personal care services so they can stay safely in their own homes. Clients can choose a family member or friend as their paid caregiver, or we find one for them.



We are a small team building for the long term. We are looking for a friendly, confident caller who wants to grow with us. The longer you stay, the more your pay, benefits and responsibilities grow.



PAY

- $5/hour base pay, about 20 hours per week

- PLUS a $50 BONUS for every 10 qualified referrals you bring in - no limit on how many bonuses you can earn

- Pay and benefits increase the longer you stay with us

- Paid twice a month (15th and 30th)



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call families and possible clients in North Dakota who have (or may qualify for) Medicaid

- Call referral partners: hospital discharge planners and social workers, clinics, senior centers, county social service offices

- Ask simple pre-screen questions (Medicaid status, county, care needs) and fill out our form

- Follow up on callbacks and log every call in our Google Sheet

- Send qualified leads to our manager, who takes it from there



Full call guide, scripts, pre-screen form and training provided.



SCHEDULE

Monday to Friday, 4 hours per day: 9 AM - 1 PM US Central Time (11 PM - 3 AM Philippine time). Same hours every day.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- US Medicaid experience STRONGLY PREFERRED - applicants with Medicaid, patient intake, or US healthcare call experience will be interviewed first

- Clear, friendly, professional spoken English

- Cold calling, telesales, appointment setting or call center experience

- Organized and reliable with follow-ups

- Stable internet, quiet workspace and a headset

- Looking for a long-term job, not a short gig



NICE TO HAVE

- Home care, personal care, home health or HCBS waiver experience

- Experience calling hospitals, social workers or case managers

- Experience with OpenPhone/Quo, RingCentral or Google Sheets



HOW TO APPLY (3 STEPS)

1. Start your message with "Optimal Care Outreach"

2. Tell us about your US Medicaid / healthcare experience (if any) and your cold calling experience: what kind of calls, how many per day, and how long

3. Attach a short voice recording (30-60 seconds) introducing yourself



Shortlisted applicants will have a short video interview and a practice call.

Journalism experience.

title: Lead Generation & Enrollment Specialist | Remote Dance Studio Sales
description:
Lead Generation & Enrollment Specialist | Remote Dance Studio Sales



If you’ve ever spotted a way to bring in customers and thought, “I’d love to be the one who runs with that,” you’ll have that opportunity here.



Your job is to figure out where our next students will come from and make the first move. You might get a local organization to introduce the studio to its families, start a conversation with a parent who’s looking for classes, or discover a referral source we’ve overlooked. The owner knows the studio and its students. You bring the outreach experience to turn that knowledge into a steady flow of interested families.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



- Generate new leads. This is your main responsibility. Choose promising outreach channels, build referral relationships, and start conversations. Track which efforts bring interested families to the studio so you know where to invest your time.

- Turn interest into enrollment. About 98% of our students are kids, so most of your conversations will be with parents. We offer adult classes too. Respond promptly to inquiries during your shifts, learn what each person is looking for, and recommend a class they’ll feel confident signing up for.

- Own the follow up. Use calls, texts, and
s to keep conversations moving. Keep the CRM current and give the owner a brief daily update on new leads, bookings, enrollments, and next steps.

- Support the studio with a weekly
 to leads, occasional social media content, and light VA tasks. Sales and outreach come first.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING



Previous sales experience is required, including experience finding your own prospects. We’ll introduce you to our classes and the families we serve. From there, you’ll d
 who to reach, what to say, and what to change when an approach gets few replies.



Strong phone skills matter here. You can put a parent at ease, ask a thoughtful question, listen to the answer, and confidently invite them to enroll. You’ll need C1 level or higher spoken and written English.



We value someone we can count on. When you tell a parent you’ll call on Thursday, you make the call. When an outreach idea shows promise, you take the next step without waiting for a reminder. Previous VA experience is preferred. CRM familiarity and an interest in dance are both welcome.



PAID TRIAL, BASE PAY, AND BONUSES



The role begins with a 2 week paid trial at 20 hours per week. You’ll receive $125 USD total for 40 hours. We’ll agree on your trial shifts in advance.



During the trial, we’ll assess your initiative, lead generation, sales ability, and reliability. We’ll look at the prospects you find independently, the conversations your outreach starts, which ones progress toward bookings or paid enrollments, and how consistently you follow through.



At the end of the trial, we’ll review the results together. If we both d
 to continue, you’ll move to 34 hours per week with a base salary of $450 USD per month, paid every 2 weeks through Wise.



You can earn performance bonuses on top of your base pay when your outreach consistently brings in multiple new paying students per month.



REGULAR SCHEDULE



All times are US Pacific Time.



Monday through Friday: 10 am to 2 pm and 4 pm to 6 pm, with a break from 2 pm to 4 pm.  

Saturday and Sunday: 10 am to noon each day.



That’s 34 hours across 7 days. Both weekend shifts are required. We’re looking for someone who wants this to be their primary long term role and can reliably cover each shift. Hours may change seasonally within the studio’s 8 am to 9 pm Pacific window. We’ll discuss and agree on any changes in advance.



HOW TO APPLY



Include “Silver Slippers” in your subject line or message title. Send your resume, confirm you can work the full regular schedule, and answer this question in a few sentences:



Tell us about one sales opportunity you created from scratch. How did you find it, what did you personally do to move it forward, and what was the outcome?

description:
Government Contract Billing & Payroll Compliance Specialist

Very Part Time (less than 5 hours a month; can lead to more hours with more types of work...(



Company: Redwood Resources

Schedule: Very part-time, as needed

Location: Remote — US Pacific Time availability required (responsive during US PST Time AND have worked US PST currently or within last 90 days.



Position overview



Redwood Resources, a public-sector consulting firm, seeks an experienced government contract billing and payroll specialist to support our accounting and project financial management functions.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience invoicing US government agencies or government contractors and understands contractual billing requirements, direct labor costs, overhead rates, fee structures and employee utilization.



We are seeking someone who can work independently, interpret contract requirements, identify discrepancies and produce accurate, audit-ready documentation with minimal supervision.



Essential responsibilities



Prepare monthly government and prime contractor invoices.



Calculate and verify base compensation rates, overhead, fees and fully burdened billing rates.



Reconcile employee timesheets, payroll records and project labor charges.



Support twice-monthly payroll processing and reconciliation.



Prepare employee billable utilization reports.



Track project budgets, expenditures, remaining contract balances and billing limitations.



Reconcile subcontractor invoices and other direct costs.



Maintain invoicing deadlines and payment tracking.



Prepare certified payroll and subcontractor utilization reports when contractually required.



Maintain complete supporting documentation for audits.



Identify and proactively communicate discrepancies before invoices or payroll are finalized.



Required qualifications



Minimum three years of hands-on US government contract billing experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise; five or more years preferred.



Demonstrated understanding of direct and indirect costs, overhead rates and contractual fee calculations.



Strong Excel skills, including lookup functions, SUMIFS, pivot tables, reconciliations and formula-based reporting.



Experience interpreting written contract and invoicing requirements.



Exceptional accuracy, responsiveness and attention to detail.



Ability to attend scheduled working sessions during US Pacific Time, including payroll and invoicing deadlines.



Ability to maintain strict confidentiality of payroll and financial information.



Preferred qualifications



Experience with architecture, engineering, transportation, infrastructure or public-sector consulting firms.



Experience with QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Time.



Familiarity with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) cost principles.



Certified payroll and prevailing wage reporting experience.



DBE/SBE utilization reporting experience.



Experience supporting government financial audits.



Application instructions



Please provide:



Your résumé and years of government contract invoicing experience.



Examples of government agencies or contractors you have supported.



The types of contracts and billing structures you have worked with.



Your experience with overhead, fees and utilization reporting.



Your availability during US Pacific Time.



Your hourly compensation expectations.



A redacted sample of a relevant invoice or financial report, if available.



Candidates must successfully complete a technical interview and live Excel assessment.
