title: AI Automation & Solutions Lead
description:
About Qore Team

Qore Team FZ-LLC is an outsourcing and business services company based in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, with remote teams in the Philippines and UAE. We support clients across different sectors. Our sister business and client, provides managed IT services to UK schools, charities and businesses.

We are looking for someone who can identify worthwhile opportunities, design realistic solutions, build automations and lead client delivery. You will work directly with Qore management and client teams, not simply produce AI demonstrations.



The work you will do - Business Transformation & Client Solutions

•  Sales: build approved prospect research, data enrichment, lead qualification and CRM workflows for BDR teams.

•  IT services: work with clients to improve ticket triage, knowledge search and service reporting.

•  Operations: streamline quotations, supplier-price checks, contract renewals, invoice preparation, timesheets and reporting.

•  Client delivery: adapt and implement proven workflows for Qore customers, then train users and maintain the finished solution.



What you will be responsible for

•  Run discovery meetings, map current processes and explain the costs, benefits and limits of proposed automation.

•  Choose suitable tools and models. Use ordinary workflow rules where AI is unnecessary.

•  Design and build reliable automations with platforms such as n8n, Make, Zoho Flow or Power Automate, using APIs and webhooks where appropriate.

•  Prepare estimates, technical scope, delivery plans, demos and quotation inputs. Work with Qore management and the sales team on proposals; management approves the final price.

•  Test, deploy, document and monitor workflows; handle errors and exceptions and hand solutions over to the client.

•  Identify work that needs custom development and brief or oversee a specialist developer rather than attempting everything personally.



What we need from you

•  Evidence of live business automations you helped design and deliver. Be ready to explain your own work, the result and how failures are handled.

•  Strong practical experience with at least one mainstream automation platform, plus confidence using REST APIs, authentication, webhooks, structured data and CRM/helpdesk integrations.

•  Working knowledge of LLMs and AI agents, including validation, accuracy limits, information security, costs and appropriate human approval.

•  Ability to turn a business problem into a clear proposal and realistic estimate, and communicate confidently with UK clients in professional spoken and written English.

•  Sound judgement with customer information. Follow client instructions, UK GDPR-related obligations, data minimisation and access controls, especially where UK schools or children’s data is involved.

•  Ability to own delivery independently, keep stakeholders informed and maintain what you deploy.



Useful, but not required

Python or JavaScript; Zoho Deluge; Microsoft Graph, Azure or SharePoint; SQL; data-enrichment products; experience in MSP, BPO or consulting environments.



You do not need to be a full-time programmer. We value sound solution design, proven low-code delivery and the ability to recognise when specialist coding is needed. You must still be technically capable of troubleshooting integrations and assessing a developer’s work.



Working arrangement

This is a long-term, full-time independent contractor role, working remotely from the Philippines. You can organise much of your working day flexibly in Philippine time. You must be available for scheduled discussions, workshops and joint implementation with UK clients and colleagues during UK business hours (GMT or BST) whenever the work requires it. We do not require a fixed UK-hours shift every day.



The engagement is paid on an agreed all-in gross monthly contractor fee. Please state your expected monthly fee in USD. You will need reliable internet, a suitable remote workspace and the ability to join professional video calls.

How to apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph:

•  Your CV, current availability and expected gross monthly fee in USD.

•  Two real automation projects you worked on. Explain the problem, tools used, your individual contribution and the result. Redacted diagrams or screenshots are welcome.

•  One example of presenting a solution, planning delivery or estimating a client project, plus your availability for UK-timezone meetings.



Shortlisted candidates will discuss a real project they delivered and complete a short practical exercise using fictional data.

title: Performance marketing video editor
description:
Performance Creative Video Editor at Phase

Remote. Freelance to start, long-term for the right person. Paid trial on a real brief.



The short version



Phase is looking for one editor who owns our video ads end to end. Not someone who cuts what they are handed. Someone who knows why an ad converts, can prove it with ads that scaled in real ad accounts, and can make it look and sound like Phase while doing it.



If you have edited for 7, 8 or 9-figure DTC brands and you think in hooks, beats and hold rate instead of transitions and LUTs, keep reading.



What Phase is



Phase is a small physical device plus an iOS app that blocks your distracting apps until you tap your phone on it. No willpower, no screen time limit you dismiss in one tap. We sell direct to consumers across Europe, with the Netherlands as home market and English as the growth language.



The category is proven and loud (Brick, Opal, Tap Out). We win on creative. That is the job.



What you will do



Edit performance video ads across the full range: UGC and creator ads, founder-led ads, AI ads (AI b-roll, AI voice, sung and 3D story formats), and high-polished brand ads.



Work from a message map, not a loose idea. Every brief names what each beat has to do. You build the edit so every beat lands: hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, CTA.



Swipe properly. Take a winning reference ad and carry over its structure, pacing, timing and shot logic beat for beat, in Phase's own style.



Iterate on signals. Read hook rate, hold rate, CTR and ROAS, d
 what the numbers are telling you, and ship the next version: new hook, new first three seconds, tighter middle, different offer line.



Make it on-brand. A Phase ad converts and still looks like Phase: our type, our colours, our tone, the real device and the real app on screen.



Make English ads, and solve the other languages. English first. Dutch and other European markets through whatever works: AI voice, dubbing, subtitles, native creators, re-cuts. We do not need you to speak every language. We need you to solve it without being asked how.



Bring ideas. Spot formats that are scaling for other brands and pitch the Phase version before we ask.

Must-haves



You have worked for real 7, 8 or 9-figure brands. Direct or through an agency. Named brands, not "a large ecommerce client".



You can show ads that performed in their ad accounts. Send the ad plus what it did: spend, ROAS or CPA, how long it ran, what 

your role was. Screenshots or numbers you are allowed to share. A reel of nice-looking edits without results does not count.



You understand marketing, not only editing. Creative strategy, awareness levels, angles, personas, hooks, message per beat, mechanism, proof, offer, CTA, pattern interrupts, pacing, retention. You know the vocabulary because you use it daily, and you can explain why one ad won and its sibling died.



You can work inside a brand system. You can make an ad that performs and is unmistakably on-brand, and you know the difference between "ugly ads work" as a tactic and sloppy work.



You work with AI and research tools every day. Claude or similar for scripting and thinking, Atria, Foreplay or the Meta Ad Library for research, and generative tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Seedance, ElevenLabs, Suno or equivalents) for b-roll, voice and music. You use them to get to a better ad faster, not as a gimmick.



Range. UGC, AI and high-polished, all three at a level you would put your name on.



Fluent English and comfortable working async with a small team.

The mindset. You treat the ad account as the scoreboard. You take ownership of Phase's video output instead of waiting for the next brief.



Bonus points in application process:



You name the brands you worked for and we can check the ads in the Meta Ad Library.



Experience in our category or next to it: screen time, focus, habits, wellness tech, consumer hardware, app plus device.



You have written or co-written the scripts and briefs for ads you edited.



You have localised winning ads into other languages before and can show the result.



Motion design or sound design beyond the basics.



How we work



Briefs live in Notion, each with a playable reference ad and a full message map. Footage, b-roll, voice-overs and brand assets sit in 
, ready to download.



Every video ships in 9:16 and 4:5.



Feedback is direct and fast. One round should usually be enough.



Make sure to add the word: f*ckAIapplications in your application, otherwise we won't check it out. 



We start with a paid trial on a real brief, built from scratch, so both sides know quickly whether it fits.

title: Customer Acquisition Specialist (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
We’re looking for someone to help us find and onboard early users for an AI tool that helps small businesses create product photos, ads, and short videos.



Your first goal is to find small business owners who sell physical products online and help them create something useful with the product. For example, you might reach out to an independent shop owner, offer to walk them through the tool using one of their own product photos, and follow up to learn whether they’d use it again.



We already have a team member creating marketing content. Your focus will be finding the right users, starting conversations, and helping interested sellers go from sign-up to their first successful result.



What you’ll do

- Choose a promising group of sellers and find relevant prospects through online shops, communities, directories, or partnerships.

- Test personalized outreach and follow up with interested sellers. Use AI and automation where they save time, such as researching prospects, preparing messages, and tracking follow-ups.

- Help new users get started and share where they get stuck or what makes them want to come back.

- Track replies, sign-ups, first successful creations, and repeat use. Share what worked and what you’d test next.



What we’re looking for

- Hands-on experience finding prospects and turning those conversations into users, trial sign-ups, or customers.

- Ability to choose a target audience, run a small experiment independently, and adjust based on the results.

- Clear written English. Experience with SaaS, e-commerce sellers, or early-stage products is a plus. Japanese language skills are a plus, but are not required.



Working arrangement

Remote and flexible, 20 hours per week, with some overlap with Eastern Time. We’d start with a short paid project, with potential for ongoing work. Please include your expected hourly rate and weekly availability.



How to apply

Tell us about one campaign where you personally found prospects and turned them into users or customers. In a few bullets, tell us who you targeted, what you did, and what results you can share. Approximate numbers are fine if you explain what they represent.

title: Short-Term Rental Claims & Payments Specialist
description:
Regal Realms manages short-term rentals in London. We are hiring a full-time, long-term member of our in-house team, working remotely from the Philippines with agreed overlap with London hours.



You will spot recoverable costs, submit evidence before the deadline and check that the money reaches our bank. You will also reconcile Guesty payouts and prepare monthly revenue reports.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



• Airbnb AirCover and host reimbursements. Identify eligible incidents from checkout and maintenance reports, gather photos and invoices, request reimbursement in the Resolution Centre and escalate eligible unpaid claims. Follow the result through to payment.

• Airbnb and Booking.com deductions. Review guest refunds, relocation charges, cancellations, no-show adjustments, commission errors and short payouts. Challenge unsupported deductions and verify reversals in the statement.

• Merchant chargebacks. Identify the disputed transaction, check for prior refunds, submit case-specific evidence before the processor deadline and verify the final debit or credit. Hand off urgent open items at the end of your shift.

• Guesty and monthly revenue. Match reservations, platform statements and processor batches to bank deposits. Report revenue by property and channel, owner amounts, Regal Realms fees and outstanding differences.



WHAT YOU BRING



Hands-on experience with Airbnb and Booking.com for an accommodation operator. You have personally handled merchant card disputes, can explain how you traced a payout to the bank and work confidently with Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with Airbnb AirCover, Guesty and GuestyPay is strongly preferred.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through this listing with your CV and two short, anonymised examples. Describe one OTA reimbursement, claim or deduction and one merchant chargeback or payout discrepancy. Tell us what you personally did, what happened and how you verified the outcome. Include your notice period and availability during London hours. Please omit guest and card data.

As our Industrial Designer, you will:



- Develop and refine 3D CAD models for packaging products, including geometry, dimensions, lids, and opening mechanisms.

- Translate sketches, product samples, and design briefs into accurate 3D models.

- Prepare technical drawings and dimensioned files for prototyping and manufacturing.

- Collaborate with our technical team to refine designs based on materials, tooling, and manufacturing requirements.

- Create photorealistic product renders, branded packaging mockups, and multi-angle product visualisations.

- Produce product animations demonstrating how packaging opens, dispenses, and functions.

- Support the development of packaging concepts for different industries and applications.

- Occasionally assist with marketing visuals and product presentation materials.



## REQUIREMENTS



We are looking for someone with:



- Proven experience in industrial design, product design, or packaging design.

- Strong proficiency in 3D modelling and CAD software.

- Experience with **SOLIDWORKS or AutoCAD** (preferred).

- Experience creating realistic product renders using KeyShot, Blender, or equivalent software.

- Ability to create product animations and demonstrate product functionality.

- Understanding of packaging materials, dimensions, tolerances, prototyping, and design for manufacturing.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical specifications.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate with an international team.



**An advantage if you have:**

- Thermoforming or packaging tooling experience.

- Experience with plastic packaging design.

- Knowledge of secondary packaging.

- Experience creating marketing materials, product one-pagers, sell sheets, and pitch decks.

- Basic graphic design skills.



## WHAT WE OFFER



- AUD 1,000 per month.

- Part-time engagement: 25 hours per week.

- Fully remote working arrangement.

- Opportunity to work on innovative packaging technology.

- Exposure to international clients and product development projects.

- Opportunity to contribute to products across multiple industries.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



1. Your updated CV or resume.

2. Your portfolio showcasing 3D packaging designs and product development work.

3. At least one example of a technical drawing.

4. Examples of photorealistic product renders.

5. At least one product animation demonstrating functionality.

6. A list of the design software you are proficient in.



**IMPORTANT:** Please include a brief explanation of your role and contribution to each portfolio project.



We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate both creative design skills and technical understanding of how products are manufactured.



We look forward to seeing your work!

title: Senior Amazon FBA Wholesale Sourcing Specialist - Multi-Category Supplier Development (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established US-based Amazon FBA wholesale seller. We are looking for ONE senior sourcing person to bring in new suppliers across categories and turn their price lists into profitable orders, working directly with the owner. This is a long-term role.



HOURS

40 hrs/week, remote. You must overlap at least 4 hours with US Central time (9 AM - 5 PM CT).



PAY

$4-5/hour depending on experience, PLUS a quarterly profit bonus: 5% of net profit on the products you source that hit our ROI target.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Supplier development (main focus)

- Find and open new wholesale suppliers in any category that works on Amazon: Health & Household, Home & Kitchen, Grocery, Pet, Baby, Sports, Tools, Beauty and more

- Target authorized distributors, brands (brand-direct) and manufacturers, in the US and internationally

- Qualify every supplier before we apply: legitimacy, brand authorization, pricing, MOQs, payment and shipping terms, landed cost for international suppliers

- Run outreach 
, phone, applications) and follow up until the account is approved

- Keep a supplier pipeline sheet updated: status, contact, terms and next step



Sourcing

- Analyze supplier price lists and catalogs (hundreds to thousands of lines) and recommend Buy / Buy smaller / Skip with quantities

- Apply our sourcing criteria: net ROI after returns, profit per unit, seller count, Amazon Buy Box share, price stability, sales velocity

- Plan replenishment for products we already sell

- Check every order before the PO goes out: exact ASIN match, pack size, Transparency, IP history, gating, hazmat and restricted-product claims



MUST HAVE

- 3+ years of US Amazon FBA WHOLESALE experience (not only online arbitrage)

- A proven record of opening wholesale accounts across several categories (brand-direct and distributors)

- Expert at Keepa: graphs, Buy Box history, seller counts, stock levels

- Strong Google Sheets skills (XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, pivot tables, cleaning messy price lists)

- Clear understanding of FBA fees, ROI vs margin, case packs and multi-packs

- Strong written and spoken English; reliable internet and a backup power source



NICE TO HAVE

- Existing distributor or brand relationships you can bring

- Importing experience: international freight, customs/duties, US labeling rules

- Ungating experience; Sellerboard, Seller Snap, SellerAmp, SmartScout or similar tools



HOW TO APPLY

Include ALL of the following in your application:

1. Years of US Amazon WHOLESALE experience, and the categories and suppliers/brands you sourced from (names are enough)

2. How many wholesale accounts (US or international) you opened in the past 12 months, in which categories, and how you find and vet new suppliers

3. Tools you use daily, with years for each

4. One example of a wholesale buy you recommended: category, ROI, units, and how it sold

5. A 3-5 minute Loom video walking through the Keepa graph of any product, explaining whether you would buy it wholesale and why

6. Your expected hourly rate and your available hours in US Central time

7. Write the word "SUPPLIERS" at the top of your application



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid 2-hour test on a real price list.

title: Senior Amazon FBA Operations Manager / Admin VA - Wholesale (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established US-based Amazon FBA wholesale seller. We are looking for ONE senior operations person to run the day-to-day back office of the business, working directly with the owner. You will own the details so nothing falls through the cracks. This is a long-term role.



HOURS

40 hrs/week, remote. You must overlap at least 4 hours with US Central time (9 AM - 5 PM CT).



PAY

$4-5/hour depending on experience, PLUS a quarterly performance bonus.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Orders and suppliers

- Track purchase orders from PO to delivery: invoices, payments, shipments, and delivery to our prep center

- Reconcile supplier invoices against units received and shipped to Amazon; chase missing units, credits and refunds

- Keep the order sheet, prep sheet and supplier records accurate and up to date



Amazon account and inventory

- Set up new SKUs and costs in Sellerboard and repricing tools (Seller Snap or similar)

- Monitor inventory and restock needs; plan and track FBA shipments and removal orders

- Find and file Amazon reimbursement claims (lost/damaged inventory, fee errors)

- Watch account health: listing issues, suppressed/stranded inventory, policy notices; prepare responses for the owner's approval



Admin and coordination

- Coordinate with the prep center on Slack: check-ins, shipments, removals and returns

- Keep weekly reports: sales and profit, open orders, credits owed, reimbursements

- Follow up on every open item until it is resolved



MUST HAVE

- 3+ years of US Amazon Seller Central back-office experience for FBA sellers (wholesale preferred)

- Hands-on experience with FBA shipments, removal orders, reimbursement cases and account health

- Sellerboard (or similar profit tool) and strong Google Sheets skills

- Very organized and detail-oriented, with clear written updates

- Strong written and spoken English; reliable internet and a backup power source



NICE TO HAVE

- Seller Snap or other repricer experience

- Bookkeeping basics (QuickBooks)

- Experience working with prep centers and US wholesale suppliers



HOW TO APPLY

Include ALL of the following in your application:

1. Years of US Amazon Seller Central operations experience, and the types of sellers you supported (wholesale, OA, private label)

2. The reimbursement and account-health cases you handled in the past 12 months, with one example and the result

3. How you track purchase orders and reconcile supplier invoices (tools and process)

4. Tools you use daily, with years for each

5. A 3-5 minute Loom video showing how you would check a seller's FBA inventory for lost or damaged units that can be reimbursed

6. Your expected hourly rate and your available hours in US Central time

7. Write the word "RECONCILE" at the top of your application



Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid 2-hour test.

title: Sales and cold calling
description:
ClaimHarbor helps individuals, estates, businesses, and nonprofits recover unclaimed property and surplus funds that may remain after foreclosure or tax sales. We’re hiring someone who can make professional outbound calls, earn trust with people who may be hearing from us for the first time, and keep our lead records accurate.



What you’ll do



- Call contacts from ClaimHarbor’s lead lists, including property owners, estate representatives, and business contacts.

- Use approved scripts to introduce ClaimHarbor, explain why we’re calling, and answer basic questions.

- Book appointments directly on the claim managers’ calendars for interested contacts. Confirm the date, time, and time zone with each contact and record the appointment in the CRM. Refer claim-specific questions to the claim managers.

- Update the CRM after each call with the outcome, notes, lead status, and next follow-up date. Correct duplicate or outdated records.

- Honor do-not-call requests, protect confidential information, and follow company outreach procedures.

- Provide a brief activity summary covering calls, appointments, and follow-ups.



What we’re looking for



- Experience with cold calling, appointment setting, or phone-based customer service.

- Clear spoken and written English and a calm, respectful phone manner.

- Experience using a CRM or spreadsheet to manage leads and follow-ups.

- Reliable internet, a headset, and a quiet workspace.

- Availability during agreed U.S. business hours, which may fall in the evening or overnight in the Philippines.



Experience in real estate, foreclosure, or unclaimed property is a plus.

title: Cold Calling Appointment Setter: US Small Businesses (Full-Time, US Hours)(MALE APPLICANTS ONLY)
description:
We are a company that builds websites for small local businesses in Colorado (plumbers, salons, restaurants,

auto shops) and then helps them get found on Google. We build the site first, free, then show it to

the owner. Your job is to call business owners, tell them we've built them something, and book a

15-minute call for our team to walk them through it.



You will:

- make 80 to 120 calls a day from our own calling system, with scripts that fill themselves in for

each business;

- log every call's outcome the same day;

- book meetings onto our team's calendar;

- practice on our AI practice line before you go live.



Your goal: one new client a week from the meetings you book, once your first month is done.



You have: at least one year of US outbound calling or appointment setting; clear, warm, natural

English; a quiet room, a headset, and reliable internet with a backup. We're looking for candidates who have previous experience working with a digital marketing agency, as the position requires familiarity with digital marketing services and communicating their value to business owners.



Schedule: full-time, Monday to Friday, US Mountain business hours.



Pay: Basic pay + Commission



To apply: start your application with the word SPARROW.



Then answer:

(1) What's the hardest objection you've handled on a cold call, and what did you say?

(2) Record a 60-second voice note introducing yourself as if you were calling a busy plumber.

title: Community Engagement Specialist (skincare industry)
description:

of the social team at a well-established clinical skincare brand. You will build the

brand's relevance beyond its own channels by joining conversations on TikTok,

Instagram, and Threads, contributing real skincare knowledge, and bringing the

brand's personality to the conversations shaping its customers' world.

This is a proactive engagement role. You will find the conversations that matter,

including skincare concerns, ingredients, trends, and cultural moments, and join

them with helpful, science-backed replies that sound native to each platform. The

ideal person blends skincare expertise with social media experience and can

translate skin science into approachable language without losing credibility. This

role is dedicated only to proactive community engagement, not customer service,

inbox management, or moderation of the brand's own channels. If you can join a

conversation confidently, explain the science in plain language, and keep a

distinct brand voice, this role is a strong fit.

What You'll Work On

Proactive Engagement

● Identify and join relevant conversations on TikTok, Instagram, and

Threads, with a focus on skincare concerns, ingredients, trends, and

cultural moments

● Bring credible, science-backed skincare knowledge into conversations

through helpful, engaging, and approachable responses

● Keep the brand's scientific authority and a conversational, culturally

relevant personality in balance so replies feel native to each platform

Collaboration and Insights

● Partner closely with the Assistant Community Manager on engagement

priorities, trending topics, and opportunities to join conversations

● Surface recurring consumer questions, emerging discussions, and

opportunities that can inform the broader content and community strategy

● Keep up with the brand's formulations, science, and messaging through

ongoing product and skincare education

Claims and Compliance

● Navigate skincare claims responsibly, with a clear line between cosmetic

education and medical advice

● Work within approved messaging and escalate anything that touches

medical claims or sensitive topics

What You Bring

● A background in esthetics, dermatology, skincare education, or a related

field, ideally paired with experience supporting a consumer-facing beauty

or skincare brand

● Experience in social media community management, especially proactive

engagement or social listening

● Experience with a science-, health-, or clinically led brand, with an

title: Virtual Assistant – Content Operations

We're a small team working in the digital content space. The work is simple, fast-moving and entirely remote.

We're looking for someone reliable, curious, and hard-working — not someone with a perfect CV. The starting salary is $400, with increases and performance-based incentives as you build skills and take on more responsibilities (e.g., Our best VAs are doing +$600 with bonuses).



What you'll actually be doing:

Most of your work involves data entry using AI tools, along with general operations support — uploading, scheduling, research, coordination, and whatever else keeps things running smoothly. If you're comfortable picking up new tools quickly and following clear instructions, you'll fit in well here.



What we're looking for

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE

ABOUT RAVORA HEALTH



Ravora Health is a growing U.S.-based outpatient mental health practice providing psychiatric evaluation, medication management, ADHD treatment, and care for conditions such as anxiety and depression.



We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Business Development & Marketing Specialist to help us grow our patient base, develop relationships with healthcare referral partners, and execute marketing and growth projects.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys research, outreach, relationship building, marketing, and solving problems.



You will work directly with Ravora Health leadership and will be given meaningful projects to own.



We are looking for someone who can take an objective, figure out what needs to be done, organize the project, execute it, follow up, and report the results.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON



1. HEALTHCARE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



A major responsibility will be helping Ravora Health build relationships with healthcare organizations that may refer patients to us.



Potential referral partners include:



* Primary care offices

* Therapy and counseling practices

* Psychologists

* Healthcare clinics

* Community organizations

* Colleges and universities

* Other healthcare professionals



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching potential referral partners

* Finding the appropriate decision-makers and contacts

* Collecting accurate phone numbers and
 addresses

* Researching services and accepted insurance plans

* Calling and
ing healthcare offices

* Introducing Ravora Health and our services

* Explaining our accepted insurance plans and referral process

* Learning how potential partners currently handle psychiatry referrals

* Scheduling meetings when appropriate

* Following up with contacts

* Maintaining long-term relationships



This is relationship-focused business development, not high-volume call-center telemarketing.



2. LEAD GENERATION & RESEARCH



You will help identify new opportunities for Ravora Health.



This may include:



* Building targeted prospect lists

* Researching healthcare organizations

* Identifying decision-makers

* Researching competitors

* Finding community organizations

* Researching local businesses and employers

* Finding potential referral sources

* Identifying marketing opportunities

* Researching new patient-acquisition channels



We want someone who is very comfortable researching online and turning information into an organized action plan.



3. REFERRAL & CONTACT DATABASE MANAGEMENT



You will help create and maintain an organized database or CRM containing information such as:



* Organization name

* Contact person

* Phone

*

* Location

* Providers

* Accepted insurance

* Services offered

* Previous communication

* Relationship status

* Last contact

* Follow-up date

* Referrals generated



You will help make sure opportunities do not get forgotten and relationships are followed up consistently.



4. DIGITAL MARKETING & PATIENT ACQUISITION



You will also assist with marketing projects designed to bring new patients to Ravora Health.



Projects may involve:



* Google Ads

* Google Business Profile

* Local SEO

* Psychology Today

* Zocdoc

* Insurance directories

* Website landing pages

*
 campaigns

* Review-generation strategies

* Provider launches

* Referral campaigns

* Social media campaigns

* Patient acquisition tracking



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



However, you should understand digital marketing and be comfortable learning new platforms.



Google Ads experience is strongly preferred but not required.



5. NETWORKING & COMMUNITY OUTREACH



Help us identify and coordinate opportunities for Ravora Health to build relationships in the community.



Examples may include:



* Healthcare networking events

* Therapist networking events

* Mental health events

* Health fairs

* Chamber of Commerce events

* Local business networking events

* College events

* Community events

* Ravora-hosted networking events



Responsibilities may include:



* Finding opportunities

* Contacting event organizers

* Gathering pricing and participation information

* Coordinating registration

* Maintaining an event calendar

* Helping prepare marketing materials

* Tracking contacts made

* Following up after events



6. MARKETING PROJECTS



You will regularly receive projects directly from Ravora Health leadership.



Examples:



"Find therapy practices in our target area that could become referral partners."



"Research PCP offices that accept the same insurance plans we accept."



"Create a system for tracking our referral relationships."



"Find networking events Ravora should attend over the next three months."



"Help us launch and market a new provider."



"Research why a particular marketing channel isn't generating enough patients."



"Find new ways we can acquire patients locally."



We are looking for someone who does not need every project broken down into individual instructions.



You should be comfortable researching, asking good questions, creating a plan, and taking ownership of execution.



AI & TECHNOLOGY



We strongly encourage the use of AI and modern technology.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* Canva

* CRM systems

* Google Workspace

* Project-management tools

* Automation tools



We want someone who looks for ways to use technology to make research, outreach, organization, and marketing more efficient.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you have experience in areas such as:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Marketing

* Healthcare

* Client relations

* Account management

* Partnership development

* Outreach

* Digital marketing

* Google Ads

* CRM management

* Project coordination

* Sales development



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare company is a strong advantage but is not required.



IMPORTANT QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:

* Excellent written English

* Confidence speaking professionally on the phone

* Strong research skills

* Strong organizational skills

* Good follow-up habits

* Professional communication skills

* Ability to work independently

* Attention to detail

* Comfort with outbound outreach

* Ability to learn new tools quickly

* Ability to manage several projects

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills



You must be comfortable communicating with U.S. healthcare offices during U.S. business hours.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST



We are not searching for someone who already knows everything.



We are searching for someone who is:



* Resourceful

* Reliable

* Organized

* Curious

* Comfortable taking initiative

* Strong at communication

* Willing to learn

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to take ownership of assignments



If we give you a goal, we want you to be able to research it, create a plan, execute it, follow up, and show us what happened.



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



Hours: 40 hours per week



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month depending on experience and skill level.



Because a significant part of this position involves communicating with U.S. healthcare offices, you must be available during a meaningful portion of U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



This is intended to be a long-term role.



Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed after the first 90 days based on performance, reliability, project ownership, and overall contribution.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



RAVORA GROWTH



Then include the following:



1. INTRODUCTION



Tell us briefly about your background and why this position interests you.



2. RESUME



Please include your current resume or CV.



3. VOICE RECORDING



Please provide a short 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself.



A major part of this role involves professional communication with U.S. healthcare offices, so spoken English is important.



4. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



Tell us about any experience you have with:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Healthcare

* Marketing

* Client outreach

* Google Ads

* CRM systems

* Project coordination



5. PROJECT OWNERSHIP



Tell us about one project where you were given a goal but not detailed step-by-step instructions.



What was the goal?



What did you do?



What was the result?



6. SHORT CASE STUDY



Imagine Ravora Health asks you:



"We want to build relationships with local therapy practices and primary care offices that could refer psychiatric patients to us."



Briefly explain how you would begin this project.



We are especially interested in how you would:



* Find potential partners

* D
 which organizations to prioritize

* Contact them

* Track your outreach

* Follow up

* Measure results



7. AI TOOLS



Tell us which AI tools you currently use and give us one example of how you have used AI to complete work more efficiently.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Ravora Health and become an important member of our business development and marketing team.

REQUIREMENTS

Our systems include Google Workspace, Trello, TTO, Clockify. Training will be provided on industry-specific software. Significant experience with Google Workspace and Trello a must. 



WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



Our office operates Tuesday to Friday and is closed on Mondays. Working hours will be during Perth business hours 9am - 12noon



All additional hours must be approved in advance.



Performance and working hours will be reviewed after three months, with opportunities for increased hours and career progression based on performance and business growth.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our company, not simply complete assigned tasks.



HOW TO APPLY



Please use the following subject line:



Ordinary Isn't in Our Vocabulary | EA | Your Full Name



Your application must include:

1. Your updated CV.

2. A brief introduction outlining your executive support experience.

3. Your expected hourly rate in AUD.

4. Your current employment and other client commitments.

5. Your availability to increase your hours in the future.

6. Two professional references.



APPLICATION TASK

You begin your three-hour shift and discover the following:

- The Founder has an important meeting in two hours that is missing from her calendar.

- A new client enquiry has been unanswered since yesterday.

- A supplier invoice is due today.

- Five administrative tasks remain outstanding.

title: Senior ComfyUI & RunPod AI Video Specialist - Hyperrealistic AI Characters
description:
# Hiring: Senior ComfyUI & RunPod AI Video Specialist — Hyperrealistic AI Characters



**Job Type:** Freelance / Part-Time (Potential Long-Term Opportunity)



**Project Overview**



We are building an automated AI video production studio that generates highly realistic, vertical talking-head videos featuring consistent virtual personalities.



Our existing system runs on RunPod and uses ComfyUI, InfiniteTalk, Python, ElevenLabs, and FFmpeg.



We are looking for an experienced specialist who can significantly improve the photorealism, motion quality, and consistency of our AI-generated characters.



**The system is already built and operational. We are not looking for someone to rebuild it from scratch.**



### Your Responsibilities



- Create exceptionally realistic AI-generated human characters.

- Improve skin texture, facial details, eyes, hair, and natural imperfections.

- Develop and optimize ComfyUI workflows on RunPod.

- Improve talking-head animation, lip-sync, and natural facial expressions.

- Reduce artificial-looking movements and visual distortions.

- Maintain consistent character identity across multiple generations.

- Optimize image-to-video settings for high-quality vertical videos.

- Create reusable avatar and environment presets.

- Troubleshoot artifacts and workflow performance issues.



### Required Experience



- Advanced experience with ComfyUI.

- Experience running AI-generation workflows on RunPod.

- Strong knowledge of AI image and video generation.

- Experience with realistic talking-head avatars and lip-sync.

- Familiarity with InfiniteTalk or comparable video-generation systems.

- Experience with reference-image consistency and character preservation.

- Ability to work with existing Python workflows.



### Ideal Candidate



You have produced AI-generated people who look convincingly real, not just beautiful AI portraits.



You understand the difference between producing an impressive still image and maintaining a believable human appearance throughout a full talking video.



### Paid Trial Project



We will begin with a paid technical test.



You will receive access to a limited copy of our existing workflow and be asked to:



1. Create one original, hyperrealistic character suitable for talking-head video.

2. Build an approved starting image with a believable environment.

3. Generate a short talking-head video using our existing system.

4. Demonstrate realistic facial movement, skin texture, and stable character identity.

5. Document your workflow and the settings required to reproduce the result.



### Application Requirements



Please send:



- Your three best examples of realistic AI human videos.

- Screenshots of ComfyUI workflows you've personally developed.

- Details of your RunPod experience.

- The AI models and techniques you currently use.

- Your hourly or fixed-project rate.

- A brief explanation of how you'd improve realism in a ComfyUI/InfiniteTalk pipeline.



**Important:** Applications without examples of actual AI-generated talking videos will not be prioritized.



We are looking for someone who can deliver measurable improvements and potentially collaborate long-term as we scale production.

Remote • First Family Trust • $800 per month

four to six partner accounts. Strong delivery may lead to ongoing partner maintenance and new launches as we grow.



Core responsibilities

n Configure GoHighLevel accounts, users, pipelines, contact fields, calendars, forms, and agreed follow-up automations.

n Build, test, and document a reusable snapshot/template, including the lead-to-booking process and partner setup steps.

title: Paid Social Campaign Assistant
description:
Role snapshot

We're looking for a Philippines-based LinkedIn and Meta Campaign Manager specialist to monitor our paid social campaigns and upload ad assets, 2 hours per weekday, on an ongoing basis.



Role

Paid Social Campaign Assistant (LinkedIn + Meta specialist)

Engagement

Ongoing, part-time, independent contractor

Hours

2 hours per day, Monday to Friday

Rate

AUD $10 per day (Australian dollars), i.e. AUD $100 per fortnight

Payment

Fortnightly via Wise, against your invoice

Schedule

A consistent 2-hour block each day, either morning or afternoon Sydney time



About us

Parachute AI is an Australian-built legal AI platform used by law firms across Australia. We're a growing startup running paid campaigns on LinkedIn and Meta to reach lawyers and law firm leaders.



What you'll do

Your main job is keeping our campaigns healthy day to day and getting new creative live quickly and accurately.

• Daily campaign monitoring (LinkedIn Campaign Manager first, then Meta Ads Manager): check spend pacing against budget, impressions, CTR, CPC, leads and lead form submissions, and flag anything unusual the same day.

• Asset uploads: upload and set up new ads (single image, carousel, video and document ads) from the briefs and files we provide, with correct copy, URLs and UTM parameters.

• Campaign housekeeping: follow our naming conventions, pause underperforming or expired ads when asked, and keep audiences and matched audience lists up to date.

• Tracking checks: confirm the LinkedIn Insight Tag, Meta Pixel and conversion events are firing and lead forms are syncing.

• Short weekly summary: a few bullet points on spend, results and anything we should change.

• Other platforms as needed: occasional work in other ad platforms (e.g. Google Ads) using the same process.

What we're looking for

Must have

• At least 1 year of hands-on experience in LinkedIn Campaign Manager (B2B campaigns preferred)

• Working experience in Meta Ads Manager

• Strong attention to detail when uploading ads and checking settings

• Clear written English and prompt replies during your agreed hours

• Reliable internet, your own computer, and a Wise account (or willingness to open one)

Nice to have

• LinkedIn lead gen forms and Insight Tag setup

• Experience with B2B, professional services or SaaS clients

• Google Ads experience

• Basic Canva skills for small creative resizes

Rate and payment

The rate is AUD $10 per day in Australian dollars (not USD or PHP) for 2 hours of work, paid fortnightly via Wise.

• Invoicing: send us an invoice in AUD every second week, listing the days worked in that fortnight (a full fortnight of 10 weekdays = AUD $100).

• Payment method: we pay via Wise to your Wise account. Wise converts to PHP at its live exchange rate, so the peso amount you receive will vary slightly with the exchange rate.

• Payment timing: paid within [X] business days of receiving your invoice.

• Contractor status: this is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. You're responsible for your own taxes and government contributions in the Philippines.

Schedule and availability

You won't set completely free hours: we need you online for the same 2-hour block every weekday, either in the morning or the afternoon Sydney time. Tell us which block you prefer when you apply.

Option

Sydney time (AEDT, Oct–Apr)

Philippines time (PHT)

Morning block

9:00–11:00 am

6:00–8:00 am

Afternoon block

1:00–3:00 pm

10:00 am–12:00 pm

Sydney is 3 hours ahead of the Philippines during Australian daylight saving (October to April) and 2 hours ahead the rest of the year, so the Philippines time shifts by an hour from April. During your block, please be reachable on Slack or
 so we can send urgent uploads or questions. Give us at least 2 days' notice for planned time off.

How to apply

Send us the following and we'll shortlist for a short video call and a paid trial task.

1.  A short intro covering your LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Ads experience

2.  One or two examples of campaigns you've managed (screenshots with client details removed are fine)

3.  Your preferred block: morning or afternoon (Sydney time)

4.  Confirmation that you're comfortable with AUD $10 per day, paid fortnightly via Wise

5.  Your earliest start date

Please start your application with the words "Parachute Campaigns" so we know you've read the full description.

We are a luxury, dermatology-focused medical aesthetics practice offering neurotoxin, fillers, collagen-building treatments, RF microneedling, laser, peels and advanced skincare. We're looking for a warm, sharp, sales-minded Virtual Assistant to be the voice of our front desk and help grow the practice.

s and Instagram/Facebook DMs during your shift. Our AI receptionist is backup only, so you are the first voice clients hear.

 list

* 60%+ booking rate from qualified leads

* 30-40 reactivation contacts daily

* 100% follow-up completion

* Accurate CRM records and on-time reports

* Pay: based on experience. Independent contractor, long-term, U.S. holiday calendar.

* Onboarding is self-guided from our VA Guide, SOPs and video tutorials

* Hiring steps: application review > video interview with role-play > paid skills test > short paid trial with practice tasks

* You'll complete HIPAA training and sign confidentiality, contractor and BAA agreements before getting access to any client system



How to Apply (read carefully)

Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph. Use the subject line "VA Application - [Your Name]" and start your message with the word GLOW. Include:

1. Resume

2. A voice or video sample (2 minutes max), recorded as if you were answering a call to our front desk

3. Work examples: social posts, CRM/GoHighLevel workflows, ManyChat flows or a blog article

4. Your exact reply to this DM: "How much is Botox? Does it hurt?"

5. Your availability (Pacific Time), time zone and desired hourly rate

6. A screenshot of your internet speed test



Incomplete applications, or ones without medical or aesthetics experience, won't be reviewed.



We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, let us know.

title: Car Rental Fleet Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on and resourceful Car Rental Fleet Manager to oversee vehicle repair coordination, maintenance scheduling, mechanic assignments, and fleet inventory management.



In this role, you will receive reports of vehicle breakdowns, mechanical issues, customer complaints, and repair requests. You will be responsible for understanding the reported issues, identifying the likely repairs needed, coordinating with available mechanics, assigning repair jobs, and ensuring that repairs are completed within a reasonable timeframe.



The ideal candidate has a good understanding of vehicle mechanics, can confidently communicate repair requirements to mechanics, and is capable of managing multiple repair jobs, schedules, and inventory requirements to keep the rental fleet operational and minimise downtime.





Key Responsibilities



Vehicle Repair Assessment and Diagnosis



Receive and assess reports of vehicle breakdowns, mechanical problems, customer complaints, and repair requests.

Understand reported symptoms and identify possible mechanical faults and the repairs required.

Conduct initial troubleshooting to determine the likely cause of vehicle issues and the urgency of repairs.

Clearly explain vehicle issues, repair requirements, and priorities to assigned mechanics.

Determine whether a vehicle requires immediate repair, further inspection, or routine maintenance.

Monitor recurring mechanical problems and recommend appropriate corrective actions.

Mechanic Assignment and Coordination



Identify and contact available mechanics or service providers based on the type of repair, availability, location, and urgency.

Assign repair and maintenance jobs to appropriate mechanics.

Coordinate with mechanics to ensure they understand the reported issue, scope of work, and expected turnaround time.

Follow up with mechanics regarding repair progress, delays, and completion.

Maintain a network of reliable mechanics and service providers who can support different vehicle repair requirements.

Coordinate additional support when a repair requires specialised expertise.

Scheduling and Fleet Maintenance



Manage and schedule vehicle repairs, maintenance, servicing, inspections, and other fleet-related work.

Coordinate mechanic schedules and assign jobs based on repair priorities and availability.

Ensure urgent vehicle issues are attended to promptly.

Monitor repair timelines and follow up to ensure jobs are completed as scheduled.

Coordinate vehicle availability with rental bookings and operational requirements.

Minimise vehicle downtime by efficiently managing repair schedules and prioritising vehicles that need to return to service.

Inventory and Parts Management



Monitor inventory of vehicle parts, tools, supplies, and other maintenance-related materials.

Identify parts required for scheduled repairs and coordinate their availability before work begins.

Track inventory usage, stock levels, and replenishment requirements.

Coordinate sourcing and purchasing of parts when necessary.

Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure commonly used parts are available to avoid unnecessary repair delays.

Fleet Monitoring and Record Management



Maintain updated records of vehicle condition, repair history, maintenance schedules, and current operational status.

Track vehicles that are available for rental, undergoing repairs, awaiting parts, or temporarily out of service.

Document repair reports, mechanic assignments, parts used, repair costs, and completion dates.

Keep relevant stakeholders updated on vehicle status, repair progress, and expected availability.

Maintain organised and accurate fleet maintenance records.

Reporting and Operational Improvement



Provide updates on outstanding repairs, mechanic assignments, vehicle availability, and inventory requirements.

Monitor repair turnaround times and identify recurring delays or operational issues.

Identify opportunities to improve mechanic coordination, scheduling, inventory management, and repair processes.

Recommend practical ways to improve fleet reliability and reduce maintenance-related downtime.



Other Responsibilities

Make necessary process suggestions and improvements which can help the team.

Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.

Perform other related tasks and duties that may be assigned by the client later on.



About You

You're a hands-on, resourceful, and highly organised professional with a strong understanding of vehicle mechanics, repair processes, and fleet maintenance operations. You're capable of assessing reported vehicle issues, identifying likely repairs, coordinating mechanics, and managing multiple repair jobs and schedules. You take ownership of issues from initial report through to resolution and are comfortable working independently in a fast-paced operational environment.



Essential Experience and Skills

3–5 years of experience in fleet management, fleet maintenance, automotive repair, workshop operations, or a related automotive role.

Strong verbal and written communication skills. 

Practical knowledge of vehicle mechanics, common mechanical faults, troubleshooting, and repair requirements.

Ability to assess vehicle breakdown reports, customer complaints, and reported symptoms to identify likely mechanical issues and determine the appropriate repairs.

Experience coordinating, scheduling, and assigning mechanics or automotive technicians based on repair requirements, availability, and urgency.

Experience managing multiple repair jobs, monitoring progress, and following up to ensure timely completion.

Knowledge of routine vehicle servicing, preventative maintenance, inspections, and repair scheduling.

Experience monitoring vehicle parts, supplies, inventory levels, and replenishment requirements.

Ability to communicate repair requirements clearly to mechanics, workshops, and service providers.

Strong organisational, prioritisation, and time management skills, particularly when handling multiple vehicles and urgent repairs.

Ability to maintain accurate records of vehicle repairs, maintenance history, mechanic assignments, inventory, and vehicle status.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions regarding repair priorities and fleet operational requirements.

Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and coordinate effectively in a remote working environment.





Nice to Have

Experience working in a car rental, vehicle hire, transport, logistics, or automotive service business.

Previous experience as an automotive mechanic, workshop supervisor, service advisor, fleet maintenance coordinator, or workshop manager.

Experience coordinating independent mechanics, external workshops, and third-party service providers.

Experience sourcing automotive parts, obtaining repair quotations, and coordinating repair costs.

Familiarity with fleet management systems, vehicle maintenance tracking tools, or inventory management systems.

Knowledge of vehicle roadworthiness requirements, inspections, and maintenance compliance.

Experience managing or coordinating the maintenance of multiple vehicles within an active rental fleet.

Experience working in a remote operations environment and coordinating with geographically dispersed teams or service providers.





Finer Details

Schedule: TBD

Start Date:

TO BE AMENDED

About Prodigy Media



Prodigy Media is an established e-commerce company with over a decade of experience developing, launching, and scaling private-label brands, primarily on Amazon USA.



We manage a diverse portfolio of brands across multiple categories and are looking for an experienced Senior Amazon Brand Manager to take ownership of brand performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead day-to-day execution.



We're looking for someone with extensive Amazon marketplace experience who understands how to grow brands, improve profitability, launch products successfully, and coordinate teams to get results.



This is a senior-level position for someone who can think strategically, solve problems independently, and take ownership of performance.



We're also embracing modern AI tools to help our team work smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Experience with Claude, Codex, or automation tools is highly valued, but strong Amazon brand management experience is our number one priority.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Brand Management & Growth

You'll be responsible for overseeing and improving the performance of assigned Amazon private-label brands.

Manage multiple Amazon brands and product portfolios.

Analyze sales, profitability, organic rankings, conversion rates, traffic, and advertising performance.

Identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve margins, and grow market share.

Develop and execute strategies to improve underperforming products.

Oversee listing optimization, SEO, A+ Content, Brand Stores, and conversion improvements.

Conduct competitive analysis and identify market opportunities.

Monitor inventory-related issues that affect sales and performance.

Develop clear short-term and long-term growth strategies for assigned brands.

Our expectation: You don't just maintain Amazon listings. You actively manage and grow the business.



2. Data Analysis, Problem Solving & Execution



Strong analytical skills are essential, but identifying problems is only the beginning.

We're looking for someone who can:

Analyze data to identify declining sales, poor conversion rates, advertising inefficiencies, and other performance issues.

Investigate the underlying causes rather than simply reporting numbers.

Develop practical solutions supported by research and data.

Implement corrective actions and coordinate the necessary resources.

Monitor results and continuously improve strategies.

Take responsibility for resolving issues from beginning to end.

We don't need someone who simply tells us what's wrong. We need someone who knows how to fix it and takes action.



3. Amazon Product Launches

Responsibilities include:

Conducting product and competitor research.

Performing keyword research and analyzing market opportunities.

Developing product launch strategies, budgets, and timelines.

Coordinating product photography, listing content, A+ Content, and launch assets.

Working with PPC specialists on launch campaigns and advertising strategies.

Planning compliant product review acquisition strategies.

Coordinating inventory readiness and launch schedules.

Monitoring launch performance and optimizing strategies to improve rankings, conversions, and sales.

You should understand the complete Amazon launch process, from preparation to successful market entry and continued growth.



4. Team Coordination & Project Management



You'll work directly with our PPC specialists, graphic designers, and operations team to ensure brand initiatives are completed effectively.

Coordinate PPC strategies and campaign priorities with advertising specialists.

Work closely with graphic designers to develop listing images, A+ Content, advertising creatives, and product videos.

Assign projects, set clear priorities, and establish realistic due dates.

Manage multiple ongoing projects and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.

Review creative assets and campaign initiatives to ensure they support brand objectives.

Identify bottlenecks and resolve delays before they affect performance.

Maintain accountability and clear communication across teams.

Use project management systems to organize assignments, responsibilities, and deadlines.

You must be comfortable leading execution, making decisions, and ensuring that important work gets completed without constant supervision.



5. External Marketing & Brand Development



While Amazon is our main sales channel, we also want to expand our brand presence and customer acquisition efforts beyond Amazon.

Experience or familiarity with the following is valuable:

 and Instagram advertising.

TikTok marketing and short-form video content.

Influencer marketing and UGC creators.

External traffic strategies that drive customers to Amazon.

Affiliate marketing and customer acquisition campaigns.

Shopify and direct-to-consumer marketing.

We're looking for someone who understands how to use outside marketing channels to build brand awareness and support Amazon sales growth.



6. AI Tools, Automation & Operational Improvements



We're continuously improving our business through AI and modern technology.

While this is not a software development position, we value Amazon professionals who are comfortable using AI to improve their productivity and solve business problems.

Experience with the following is a strong advantage:

Claude and Claude Code.

OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT.

AI-assisted Amazon research, analytics, and reporting.

Automating repetitive business tasks and workflows.

Building or customizing simple internal tools using AI.

We especially value people who are willing to invest time in exploring AI-powered applications or automations that eliminate operational bottlenecks and help the company operate more efficiently.



Minimum Qualifications



Required:

Direct experience successfully launching new products on Amazon.

Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon SEO, listing optimization, and advertising fundamentals.

title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper — Multi-Entity (QuickBooks + Tekmetric) | US Auto Repair Group
description:
We're a US-based holding company that owns and operates a growing group of independent automotive repair shops across Texas. We acquire shops and bring them onto a shared accounting platform, so the books span multiple legal entities (operating companies, a holding company, and property-holding entities) with transactions flowing between them.

You'll own the day-to-day and month-end books across all entities in QuickBooks Enterprise. A US CPA reviews and files; your job is to deliver clean, reconciled, close-ready books and supporting schedules every month so that review is fast and the filings are accurate. This is a finance-operations role, not data entry. As we close new acquisitions, you'll onboard each new shop into the books — so the role grows with the portfolio.



What you'll own



- Multi-entity bookkeeping in Quickbooks — maintain accurate books across the holding company, multiple operating shops, and property entities.

- Accounts payable — enter and code vendor bills (including auto parts and tire suppliers), manage the AP schedule, prep payment runs for approval.

- Accounts receivable — record customer invoicing where applicable and follow up on open balances.

- Payroll — record and reconcile payroll across entities.

- Reconciliations — monthly bank and credit-card reconciliations for every entity, plus loan and liability accounts.

- Parts cost reconciliation — match parts purchases and repair orders from our shop-management system (Tekmetric) against QuickBooks; investigate and flag variances between what was bought, what was billed, and what was booked.

- Intercompany — track and keep clean the transactions between entities (rent between property and operating companies, management fees from the holding company, owner draws/loans).

- Month-end close — accruals, prepaids, reconciliations, and supporting schedules; deliver close-ready books to our CPA for review and filing.

- Reporting — monthly P&L and balance sheet by entity plus a consolidated view; proactively flag anomalies, margin movements, and anything that looks off.

- New-shop onboarding — when we acquire a shop, set up or clean its chart of accounts, load opening balances, and standardize it onto our platform.

- Documentation & support — maintain a clean audit trail and support diligence, lender/SBA reporting, and annual tax prep.



Requirements



- 5+ years of full-charge bookkeeping for US-based clients (multi-entity experience strongly preferred).

- Expert in QuickBooks 

- Comfortable working on the accrual basis and running a month-end close.

- Strong reconciliation discipline and obsessive accuracy — you catch the small stuff before it compounds.

- Clear written English and proactive communication — you flag issues early instead of sitting on them.

- Reliable computer (i5 or better, 8GB+ RAM) and internet 50 Mbps; able to work the overlap window above.

- Looking for a long-term, full-time, single-client commitment.



Bonus (not required, but moves you to the top of the pile)



- QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.

- Experience with auto repair, multi-location retail, or field-service businesses.

- Familiarity with a shop-management system (Tekmetric, Shopmonkey, Mitchell, etc.) and/or a parts/spend reconciliation tool (WickedFile, Ramp).

- Experience supporting a US CPA through close and tax filing.

- Experience onboarding newly acquired entities (roll-up / M&A bookkeeping).



Why this role

You'll be the financial backbone of a fast-growing operator, with real ownership and visibility into how acquisitions are run. As the portfolio grows, there's room to take on more responsibility and eventually help build out a small finance team. We pay above the local market for the right person and reward people who take ownership.

- Work US business hours (9am-5pm Eastern, Monday-Friday)



WHAT WE NEED

- 1+ year of US outbound sales or cold calling experience (closing, not just appointment setting)

- Clear, confident English with a neutral accent

- Quiet room, headset, stable internet (25+ Mbps) and backup power

- Organized: you will juggle several same-day callbacks at once

PAY

- $500-650/month base (based on experience) plus commission on every client you close:

  - Setup fee + monthly plan: $250 per close

  - $0 upfront + monthly plan (backup offer): $50 per close, paid once the client's second monthly payment clears

- 2-week paid trial. Top performers get raised base and bonuses.

- Example: 3 setup-fee closes + 3 backup closes a month = $900 in commission on top of base



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word "PREVIEW" so we know you read this.

2. Send a 1-2 minute voice recording of you pitching an example website sale to a business owner (Vocaroo or Google Drive link).

title: Qualified High School English Teacher | Online Teaching | US & Australian Students
description:
About The Classic High School Teacher



The Classic High School Teacher is a growing international education company supporting teenagers and their families across the United States, Australia and Canada.



Founded by an experienced secondary school teacher, our business is built on a simple belief:



**Teenagers deserve to be taught by actual teachers.**



We specialise in helping students develop the English skills they need to succeed in secondary school, particularly reading comprehension, literary analysis, analytical writing and essay development.



We are launching **The English Lab**, a premium online English teaching programme, and are recruiting qualified secondary school English teachers to join our founding teaching team.



## Who We Are Looking For



**You must be a qualified secondary/high school English teacher with genuine classroom teaching experience.**



We are NOT looking for general English tutors, ESL conversation teachers, university students or individuals whose experience is limited to online tutoring.



We want professional educators who understand how teenagers learn, how to plan effective lessons, how to assess student writing and how to explicitly teach challenging English concepts.



You should be confident teaching students aged approximately 13–16 and comfortable working with international families.



### Essential Qualifications



Applicants must meet ALL of the following requirements:



- Hold a Bachelor's degree in Secondary Education, majoring in English, or an equivalent recognised secondary English teaching qualification.

- Hold a valid Philippine Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) teaching licence, or an equivalent recognised professional teaching credential.

- Have at least two years of actual secondary/high school English classroom teaching experience.

- Have experience teaching literature, reading comprehension, analytical writing and essay composition.

- Demonstrate excellent spoken and written English.

- Understand lesson planning, curriculum expectations, assessment and differentiated instruction.

- Be confident teaching English to students aged 13–16.

- Be able to provide evidence of teaching qualifications, employment history and professional references.



**Please do not apply if your only experience is ESL tutoring, conversational English teaching or informal tutoring.**



## About The English Lab



Our private English programme provides intensive, individualised English instruction.



Each student receives:



- Three 60-minute private English lessons every week.

- A structured ten-week programme.

- Thirty individual teaching sessions.

- A dedicated, qualified English teacher.

- Personalised learning goals and targeted instruction.

- Regular assessment, written feedback and progress reporting.



Students remain with the same teacher throughout their programme to ensure continuity and meaningful academic support.



## Your Responsibilities



As an English Lab teacher, you will:



- Plan and deliver high-quality, individualised English lessons via Google Meet.

- Explicitly teach literary analysis, essay writing, reading comprehension and analytical thinking.

- Assess students' existing skills and identify gaps in understanding.

- Model effective writing and thinking strategies.

- Provide guided and independent practice.

- Assess written work and provide actionable feedback.

- Adapt teaching to individual students' learning needs.

- Maintain accurate lesson records and monitor academic progress.

- Prepare weekly parent progress updates using our templates.

- Communicate professionally with our programme coordinator.

- Maintain consistent teaching availability throughout each ten-week programme.



## Teaching Specialisations



We are recruiting teachers with particular strengths in one or more of these areas.



**1. Secondary English Writing & Composition**



Supporting reluctant writers, teaching sentence and paragraph construction, developing written responses and building writing confidence.



**2. Literature & Literary Analysis**



Teaching students how to interpret literature, analyse language techniques, evaluate evidence and construct meaningful analytical responses.



**3. Academic Writing & Essay Development**



Teaching structured essays, extended analytical responses, argument development, sophisticated written expression and critical thinking.



## Experience With Diverse Learners



Many families who work with The Classic High School Teacher have teenagers who experience difficulties with writing, attention, executive functioning or learning confidence.



Experience teaching students with ADHD, autism, dyslexia or other learning differences is highly desirable.



We value teachers who are patient, encouraging, adaptable and skilled at breaking complex tasks into manageable steps.



## Working Hours



This is a remote, part-time teaching position.



You will teach students from the United States, Australia and potentially Canada.



We are particularly interested in teachers who can offer consistent teaching availability during international after-school hours.



You must be able to commit to the same weekly teaching schedule for a minimum of ten consecutive weeks.



As our programme grows, additional teaching hours may become available.



## What We Provide



- An established international education brand.

- A structured English teaching philosophy and programme framework.

- Access to teaching resources and lesson materials.

- Administrative and student onboarding support.

- Consistent student placements based on availability.

- Opportunities for ongoing teaching contracts.

- A supportive, teacher-led working environment.



## Application Requirements



Please submit the following:



**1. Teaching qualifications**



Your degree, PRC licence details and any additional professional teaching qualifications.



**2. Secondary classroom experience**



The schools where you have taught, year levels taught and number of years of classroom experience.



**3. Teaching specialisation**



Tell us whether your strongest area is writing composition, literary analysis or academic essay writing.



**4. International teaching experience**



Have you taught students following US, Australian, British or other international English curricula?



**5. Your availability**



Provide your preferred teaching days and times in Philippine Time.





**6. A 3–5 minute teaching demonstration video**



Imagine you are teaching a 14-year-old student who can identify a quotation in a novel but struggles to explain its meaning.



Demonstrate how you would teach this student to move from identifying evidence to analysing it.



We are looking for clear explanations, explicit modelling, strong subject knowledge and a warm, professional teaching style.



**7. Your CV and professional references**



Please include your teaching employment history and at least two professional referees.



### Important



To confirm you have read the requirements, begin your application with:



**"I am a qualified secondary English teacher."**



Only applicants who meet our professional teaching qualification and classroom experience requirements will be considered.



We look forward to welcoming exceptional secondary English teachers to The English Lab.



**The Classic High School Teacher**  

*The English Lab*
