 and social media marketing; GoHighLevel CRM and automations; landing pages and funnels; and ongoing website support. We value quality, efficiency, accountability, and strong client relationships.

The Role Overview

We’re seeking a dependable General & Technical Virtual Assistant to work directly with the founder. Your primary focus will be hands-on technical implementation and client support: updating existing WordPress and Shopify sites, configuring GoHighLevel workflows and funnels, handling routine client requests, and preparing reports. General administrative support, including inbox, calendar, research and data entry, will be a secondary part of the role.





The goal is to reliably execute clearly scoped work using existing tools, templates and processes, keep client requests moving, and reduce the founder’s workload. This is an implementation and support position, not a senior developer, advanced automation architect or project management role. You should be organized, resourceful, proactive and comfortable asking questions when a task exceeds your experience.

What We’re Looking For

Secondary General Assistant Skills

Executive and administrative assistance for a business owner

Inbox triage,
 drafting, calendar coordination and scheduling

Professional first-level customer support and client communication

Online research, accurate data entry, spreadsheet and contact-list maintenance

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong organization, prioritization, discretion and proactive updates

Essential Technical Implementation Skills

GoHighLevel: subaccounts, pipelines, workflows,
/SMS automations, forms, calendars and funnels

WordPress: content updates, plugin management, troubleshooting and routine maintenance

Elementor and WPBakery: page population, layouts and responsive fixes

Shopify: products, collections, pages, apps and basic storefront changes

HTML and CSS: practical styling and layout changes

Basic website troubleshooting: identify common plugin, formatting, form and layout issues, and escalate more complex problems

Troubleshooting and testing website functionality and CRM automations

Nice-to-Have Skills

 Basic PHP, WooCommerce, WPML, Shopify Liquid and complex troubleshooting

Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics and Tag Manager

Zapier, Make, APIs, DNS/hosting and advanced integrations

ClickUp, Asana or Trello

Previous agency experience

Core Responsibilities

1. WordPress & Shopify Website Support

Update text, images, pages, products and site content within existing websites

Populate website builds with supplied copy and assets

Adjust Elementor and WPBakery layouts, including mobile responsiveness

Perform routine plugin and site updates and investigate common issues; escalate complex errors

Implement approved scripts, tracking codes and integrations

Make basic HTML and CSS adjustments within existing layouts

Test forms, links, buttons and site functionality; escalate advanced development

2. GoHighLevel CRM & Funnel Implementation

Set up client subaccounts, pipelines and opportunity stages using established processes

Configure standard
/SMS workflows, forms, surveys, calendars and landing pages from briefs or templates

Duplicate and populate funnels using existing templates

Import, clean, tag and segment contacts; configure custom fields

Assist with standard domain connections and approved integrations using documented steps

Test triggers, automations, forms and lead routing; document setups

3. Customer Support & Client Communication

Acknowledge routine client inquiries and technical support requests

Gather missing information, share approved updates and record resolutions

Escalate sensitive, complex or high-impact matters to the founder

4. Client Reporting & Weekly Recaps

Gather performance metrics and activity updates from relevant platforms

Prepare weekly client summaries of completed work, leads, spend, CPC/CPL where relevant

Highlight outstanding items, risks and upcoming priorities

Maintain reporting spreadsheets and draft client updates for review

5. Quality Control & Proactive Problem Solving

Test changes on desktop and mobile before marking tasks complete

Verify forms, links, integrations and automations

Catch formatting errors, missing assets and incorrect settings

Document unresolved issues, communicate blockers early and suggest improvements

Handle credentials and client data securely

6. Executive & Administrative Assistance

Help organize the founder’s daily reminders, assigned tasks and follow-ups

Schedule meetings and maintain files, documents and client information

Prepare meeting notes, summaries, action items and routine documents

Keep task lists and assigned project information current

7. Inbox & Calendar Management

Monitor, sort and prioritize incoming messages

Draft routine responses and flag urgent client requests

Coordinate appointments and meeting availability

Track outstanding communications and follow up when authorized

8. Research, Data Entry & Community Engagement

Conduct assigned research on potential clients, industries and business opportunities

Identify and join relevant groups using authorized accounts

Engage authentically in appropriate conversations and track activity

Maintain research spreadsheets, contact records and lead trackers

Follow platform rules and approved outreach guidelines

Performance Expectations & Progression

90-Day Trial: You’ll start at $6 USD/hour. During the first three months, we expect you to:



1. Complete at least 10 routine website updates or technical support requests accurately, including testing before completion.



2. Configure or meaningfully support at least 3 GoHighLevel client setups, workflows, funnels or CRM implementations.



3. Independently manage routine inbox, calendar, research and administrative assignments with minimal follow-up.



4. Deliver 100% of assigned weekly client recaps on schedule, with accurate activity and performance information.



5. Maintain an average 24–48-business-hour turnaround for standard website and CRM support requests when required access and assets are available.



After 90 Days: If you consistently meet these expectations, deliver quality work and operate with minimal oversight, your rate increases to $7 USD/hour following a successful performance review.

Key Performance Metrics

• Task completion: 95% of assigned tasks on time

• Accuracy: 95% without significant errors or rework

• Communication: clear daily updates on scheduled workdays

Responsiveness: acknowledge new tasks within 2 working hours

Website support: routine requests typically completed within 24–48 business hours, subject to complexity

CRM implementation: standard setups within agreed deadlines

Client reporting: 100% of assigned weekly recaps on time

Proactivity: at least 2 useful improvements or identified issues per week

Working Hours & Availability

This is a full-time remote contract position requiring 40 hours per week, typically Monday through Friday, 8 hours per day. Maintain a consistent agreed schedule with at least 4 hours of daily overlap with Eastern Time in Montreal (which observes daylight saving time). Attend scheduled check-ins, communicate during work hours, meet deadlines and provide advance notice of planned absences.

Must-Have Qualities

Detail-oriented: catch errors before they reach clients

Self-starter: investigate and execute without constant supervision

Resourceful: research and troubleshoot effectively

Organized: manage competing tasks and deadlines

Reliable communicator: provide updates and flag blockers

Fast learner: adapt to new platforms and processes

Accountable: own mistakes and resolve problems

Professional and trustworthy: protect confidential client information

Why Join Aura Designs?

Work directly with an experienced agency founder and gain practical exposure to WordPress, Shopify, GoHighLevel, automation and digital marketing. Enjoy diverse projects, remote work, professional development and the opportunity to grow into a trusted long-term team member.

How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Resume or professional profile showing relevant general and technical VA experience.

2. Examples of GoHighLevel setups, workflows or funnels you’ve implemented.

3. Examples of WordPress or Shopify websites you’ve maintained.

4. Summary of Elementor, WPBakery and basic HTML/CSS skills; mention PHP only if applicable.

5. Examples of inbox, calendar, customer support or research work.

6. Timezone, working hours and confirmation of 40-hour weekly availability.

7. Short introduction explaining why you’re a fit.

Bonus: Describe a website or CRM problem you investigated and resolved.





Apply here: 





We value practical experience, initiative, reliability and problem-solving over formal qualifications.

title: Real Estate Team Lead – Australian Buyers Agency (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
Lead a growing Australian property team, remotely, from the Philippines.



Are you an experienced real estate professional who loves bringing order to a busy pipeline and helping a team do its best work? Charlie Property is looking for a Team Lead to own our Buyers Agency: its people, its client journey, and its growth.



THE QUICK DETAILS

- Role: Buyers Agency Manager (Team Lead)

- Reports to: Chief Operations Officer, with a direct line to the Director on strategy

- Setup: Independent contractor, full-time (40 hours/week)

- Ramp-up: Part-time (20 hours/week) during training and probation, then full-time

- Schedule: Monday to Friday, within Melbourne business hours (AEST/AEDT), including our weekly Buyers Agency meeting every Tuesday at 1:00 PM Melbourne time

- Rate: USD 8 to 10 per hour

- Start: As soon as possible

- Location: Remote, must be based in the Philippines



WHO WE ARE

Charlie Property is an Australian property investment business led by Director Charles Corby. We buy, renovate and hold residential property with our money partners, and our Buyers Agency helps clients buy the right property. Our team works remotely across Australia, the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia.



We celebrate differences. We value open communication, different points of view and respectful debate, and we use AI tools and clear systems every day to work smarter.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

You'll lead a team of four (Sales and Customer Success) across Australia, Vietnam and Indonesia, making sure every client moves smoothly from first call to settlement. This is a non-transacting role: you lead and coordinate the team, and you won't act as the buyer's agent for clients.



Day to day, you will:

- Lead your team with weekly 30-minute one-on-ones, clear weekly priorities, and early, kind feedback

- Run the weekly Buyers Agency meeting and make sure every action has one owner and a due date in ClickUp

- Within your first 30 days, map out and document who owns each step of the client journey

- Review the GoHighLevel pipeline at least twice a week, chase stuck clients, and make sure every new client comes through the application form

- Lead strategy for client acquisition, agent relationships and off-market deal flow (including stale-listing agent outreach), and bring one improvement or test to the Director each month

- Be the main point of contact for Acquisitions, Marketing and Finance

- Keep Buyers Agency SOPs current, including the AML SOP and client expectation-setting

- Help keep the team within real estate licensing rules, making sure licensed work goes to a licensed person

- Send the Director a short weekly report every Friday: pipeline by stage, clients signed, deals presented, settlements, blockers and decisions needed



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- By day 30: client journey ownership is agreed and documented, and all carried-over actions are closed or re-planned with an owner

- Every week: a clear update is sent to the Ops Team

- Ongoing: ready-to-sign clients move to contract, conversion is tracked by stage in GoHighLevel, and agent outreach runs daily across NSW, VIC and QLD



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE

- Several years working in or managing an Australian buyers agency, and 3+ years in Australian residential property

- 3+ years leading or coordinating a team (remote or cross-cultural is a big plus)

- A solid understanding of investing strategies like buy-and-hold, renovation and flipping

- Experience running a sales or client pipeline with targets

- Confidence with GoHighLevel, ClickUp and Google Workspace, and the ability to own and fix them

- Clear, warm and direct communication

- Availability during Melbourne business hours



BONUS POINTS FOR

- A real estate licence or Cert IV in Real Estate Practice

- Experience running a property education course or program

- Experience with RP Data (CoreLogic) or similar

- Using AI tools in your daily work



TOOLS YOU'LL USE

ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace, Jibble, Claude (AI assistant), GoHighLevel, RP Data (CoreLogic), and Webflow (via Marketing)



HOW WE WORK

- Remote first: we write things down and keep tasks updated in ClickUp

- Daily rhythm: clock in with Jibble, join the daily AI Hour, and send an EOD report before logging off

- Weekly check-ins: all-hands meeting plus a 1:1 with your manager

- Growth: team coaching with an external coach, AI training, and the chance to build systems that make work easier



WHAT WE OFFER

- USD 8 to 10 per hour

- Remote, full-time role within Melbourne business hours

- A part-time start during training and probation, so you can learn our systems before moving to full-time

- A daily AI Hour to learn and use AI tools at work

- Team coaching sessions with an external coach



HOW TO APPLY

Please read carefully. Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed.



1. Use this subject line: "Team Lead Application – [Your Full Name]"

2. Start your message with the words "Settlement Ready" so we know you read the full post

3. Attach your CV or resume

4. Include a link to a short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself and sharing why this role is right for you

5. Answer these questions in your message:

   a. How many years have you worked with an Australian buyers agency, and what was your role?

   b. How many people have you led, and were they remote?

   c. Which CRM or pipeline tools have you used, and how did you use them to track conversions?

   d. Imagine you join and find clients stuck in the pipeline with no clear owner. What would you do in your first two weeks?

   e. Are you available Monday to Friday during Melbourne business hours, including Tuesdays at 1:00 PM Melbourne time?



OUR HIRING PROCESS

1. Application and video review

2. Interview with the Chief Operations Officer and Director

3. Paid trial task

4. Offer and onboarding



We're excited to hear from you!

title: Social Media Content Creator & Short-Form Video Editor – Beauty & Lifestyle

Experience editing Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, and short-form social media content.



Proficiency in CapCut, Canva, or similar editing software.



Strong understanding of current beauty, lifestyle, and influencer trends.



Understanding of what attracts and engages a female audience.



Good English communication and caption-writing skills.



Ability to work independently, take creative initiative, and meet deadlines.

I am looking for someone who can bring creativity and fresh ideas to my content while saving me time and helping me build a recognizable personal brand that attracts both followers and potential brand partnerships.

title: Amazon DSP Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Demand-Side Platform (DSP) Specialist to manage, optimize, and scale Amazon DSP advertising campaigns across multiple client accounts, with additional experience in Amazon PPC advertising.



This is a client-facing role. The ideal candidate can present performance updates, explain advertising strategies, answer client questions, and provide clear, data-driven recommendations. The primary focus is DSP strategy, audience targeting, optimization, and performance analysis, while PPC knowledge supports integrated advertising plans. The specialist will work closely with the Amazon Advertising Lead.



Key Responsibilities

Amazon DSP Campaign Management (Primary Focus)

* Manage and optimize Amazon DSP campaigns across multiple client accounts.

* Develop full-funnel DSP strategies for awareness, acquisition, retargeting, and conversion.

* Build campaigns using first-party audiences, behavioral and contextual targeting, and custom audiences.

* Manage prospecting, remarketing, and competitor conquesting initiatives.

* Optimize budgets, bids, audience segments, frequency caps, placements, and creative performance.

* Analyze campaign, audience, placement, and ASIN-level results; track spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rates, reach, frequency, and attributed sales.

* Use Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), where available, to support audience insights and measurement.

* Audit campaigns, identify wasted spend and incremental growth opportunities, and maintain effective budget pacing.

* Partner with creative teams to assess display, video, and other DSP assets



Amazon PPC Management (Secondary Focus)

* Support Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

* Apply working knowledge of keywords, product targeting, match types, bids, and placements.

* Review ACoS, ROAS, TACoS, CTR, CPC, and conversion performance.

* Coordinate DSP and PPC strategies to support overall sales and advertising efficiency.



Performance Analysis & Strategic Growth

* Identify trends, inefficiencies, growth opportunities, and potential root causes of performance changes.

* Consider organic sales, product rankings, pricing, inventory, and conversion rates when making recommendations.

* Develop and execute structured tests of audiences, creatives, placements, and campaign formats.

* Evaluate how DSP and PPC contribute together to broader Amazon advertising goals.



Client Communication & Reporting

* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.

* Join client meetings, present results, and explain strategy and next steps clearly.

* Proactively communicate risks, opportunities, and data-backed recommendations.

* Document campaign optimizations, tests, findings, and decisions.



AI, Automation & Advertising Technology

* Use approved AI, analytics, automation, and advertising tools to improve efficiency and decision-making.

* Automate appropriate repetitive work without compromising accuracy.

* Stay current with Amazon DSP developments and advertising best practices.



Requirements

* 5+ years of hands-on Amazon advertising experience, including significant direct Amazon DSP campaign management.

* Strong expertise in DSP campaign setup, audience targeting, full-funnel strategy, optimization, reporting, and budget management.

* Working knowledge of Amazon PPC and Sponsored Ads campaign types.

* Understanding of attribution, campaign performance metrics, and profitability analysis.

* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

* Ability to manage multiple client accounts independently, diagnose problems, and meet deadlines.

* Excellent written and spoken English, including confidence presenting to U.S. clients.

* Comfortable with AI tools, automation, and advertising management software.



Preferred Experience

* Advanced DSP experience across multiple brands or agency accounts.

* Experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud, including audience creation and advanced measurement.

* Familiarity with Amazon Marketing Stream, third-party reporting tools, and advertising data integrations.

* Experience coordinating DSP and PPC strategies.

* Experience with Streaming TV, online video, and non-endemic advertising.



Performance KPIs

1. DSP Account Performance

* Meet or progress toward agreed ROAS, CPA, sales growth, reach, and other client goals.

* Identify declines early, improve efficiency, scale strong campaigns, and pace budgets appropriately.



Target: Managed accounts meet or make measurable progress toward agreed monthly objectives.



2. Campaign Optimization & Execution

* Complete scheduled optimizations and approved launches on time.

* Maintain accurate structures, targeting, naming, and documentation.



Target: Planned tasks completed on time with minimal execution errors.



3. Proactive Growth & Strategic Recommendations

* Identify new audiences, targeting approaches, and campaign expansion opportunities.

* Recommend structured tests and better coordination between DSP and PPC.



Target: At least two meaningful recommendations per account per month, where applicable.



4. Client Communication

* Come prepared with insights and next steps.

* Communicate issues proactively and respond accurately and professionally.



Target: On-time client deliverables without recurring communication issues.



5. Reporting & Analysis

* Deliver accurate weekly and monthly reports.

* Explain what changed, why it changed, and what should happen next.



Target: 100% of reports delivered by deadline with accurate, actionable insights.



6. AI & Tool Adoption

* Use approved tools and identify safe automation opportunities.

* Adapt to new workflows and demonstrate efficiency improvements.



Target: Consistent tool adoption and measurable workflow improvement.



What We're Looking For

We need someone who thinks beyond bid adjustments: an independent, strategic operator who can identify promising audiences, balance prospecting and retargeting, spot wasted spend, determine which campaigns merit investment, connect DSP with PPC, diagnose performance changes, and confidently explain recommendations to clients.



Success in This Role

Success means delivering against client objectives, maintaining strong execution standards, proactively identifying growth opportunities, and communicating clearly. The ideal candidate combines deep Amazon DSP expertise with practical PPC knowledge, strong analytical judgment, and independent multi-account management.

title: Amazon E-commerce Paid Media Marketing Manager
description:
Who We Are

With expertise in Web Development, e-Commerce Management, Data Analytics, and Graphic Design, we offer globally competitive solutions that empower our clients’ businesses to excel in today’s market.

• Strong operator who can both think and execute

• Comfortable managing designers and creative workflows

• Detail-oriented with a strong eye for good design (U.S. market taste)

• Skilled in or comfortable with AI-assisted copywriting

• Highly organized and able to manage many moving pieces

• Scrappy, proactive, and accountable

• Experienced with paid media and performance marketing across Amazon and ideally Meta and/or TikTok

• Highly self-motivated and comfortable operating independently with minimal supervision

• Proactively identifies what needs to be done, establishes priorities, and follows through without waiting for direction

• Strong analytical judgment with the ability to turn performance data into clear actions and recommendations

• Takes full ownership of outcomes and communicates early when priorities, risks, or performance change



💼 Work Setup

• Independent Contractor (monthly renewable contract) - 40 hours per week

• Remote or work-from-home arrangement

• Time Schedule: US hours (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM PST or night shift in PH)

• Time tracker: Time Doctor

• Observance of US Holidays (Or willingness to work during PH holidays)

• Salary - depending on the qualifications



If you’re a proactive Amazon eCommerce and Paid Media professional who can take ownership, make data-driven decisions, and drive continuous growth with minimal supervision, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Outbound E-commerce Sales Representative
description:
Job Position: Outbound E-commerce Sales Representative



Work Setup & Shift: Remote (Work From Home) | Must be available to work US business hours



The Opportunity

💰 Unlimited performance-based bonuses

📈 Thousands of leads per day from post-purchase customers and abandoned checkouts

💻 100% remote (work from home)



You'll Have

The opportunity to help US pet owners discover practical pet care solutions for their dogs and cats.

A performance-driven sales environment focused on checkout recovery, post-purchase sales, and revenue growth.

Sales scripts, product training, and coaching to support your professional development and performance.

The opportunity to contribute directly to sales growth, customer retention, and an excellent customer experience.





Your Role

As an Outbound Sales Representative, you will engage potential and existing customers to recover abandoned checkouts, generate additional sales, and recommend relevant pet care products. You will focus on understanding customer needs, addressing concerns, and identifying opportunities to increase order value while delivering a positive customer experience.



Your responsibilities will include:

Make outbound calls to customers who have abandoned their checkouts or left their orders incomplete.

Re-engage potential customers, identify purchase barriers, address concerns, and help them complete their orders.

Contact existing customers to identify post-purchase sales opportunities, recommend complementary products, and encourage repeat purchases when appropriate.

Recommend relevant pet care products, accessories, bundles, and add-ons based on customers' previous purchases, pet care needs, and product interests.

Build rapport with customers and use active listening to understand their needs, preferences, and purchasing concerns.

Confidently present pet care products and explain their features, benefits, proper use, and value.

Handle objections related to price, product suitability, shipping, trust, and purchase hesitation professionally.

Close sales over the phone whenever possible and guide customers through the approved checkout or payment process.

Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and increasing average order value without making irrelevant or excessive product recommendations.

Follow up with eligible leads and existing customers through approved communication channels.

Meet daily and monthly sales targets, conversion goals, call activity expectations, and average order value objectives.

Accurately document call outcomes, customer feedback, objections, purchases, and follow-up actions in the designated systems.

Follow approved sales scripts, standard operating procedures, customer privacy requirements, and escalation guidelines.

Escalate product concerns, order issues, complaints, and other matters outside the scope of sales responsibilities to the appropriate team.

Collaborate with team leaders and management to improve sales techniques, customer engagement, conversion rates, and overall team performance.

Maintain a customer-first approach while consistently working toward revenue growth and sales targets.





Skills & Qualifications



Required Experience

At least more than 3-5 years of experience in outbound sales, telesales, telemarketing, or phone-based B2C sales.

Previous experience selling to customers in the US market is strongly preferred.

Demonstrated ability to close sales over the phone and consistently meet sales targets.

Experience handling objections, following up with leads, and converting potential customers into paying customers.

Experience in e-commerce, direct-to-consumer (DTC), abandoned-checkout recovery, upselling, cross-selling, or repeat-customer sales is a strong advantage.

Experience managing both prospective customers and existing customers is preferred.





Communication & Sales Skills

Advanced spoken English proficiency with clear pronunciation, strong comprehension, and natural conversational ability.

Excellent phone etiquette, active listening, and interpersonal skills.

Ability to build rapport quickly and communicate effectively with US customers.

Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.

Ability to identify customer needs and recommend appropriate products rather than relying solely on scripted pitches.

Confidence in handling both first-time buyers and existing customers.

Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail when documenting customer interactions.





Pet Knowledge & Product Interest

Genuine interest in pets, particularly dogs and cats.

Familiarity with pet care needs.

Ability to learn product features, benefits, proper use, and limitations and explain them accurately to customers.

Previous experience in the pet industry or selling pet care products is a strong advantage.





Performance & Work Habits

Ability to meet daily and monthly sales targets, conversion goals, productivity metrics, and other assigned KPIs.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Resilience when handling rejection, objections, and difficult conversations.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining accountability.

Willingness to receive coaching, participate in call evaluations, and continuously improve sales performance.

Ability to follow established workflows, maintain accurate customer records, and escalate concerns appropriately.

Ability to balance sales performance with a positive, professional, and customer-focused approach.





Technical Requirements

Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote-work environment.

A reliable computer, headset, and quiet workspace & back up power station.

Familiarity with CRM systems, e-commerce platforms, and cloud-based calling tools.

Experience with Shopify, Aircall, Consio, Gorgias, or similar platforms is an advantage.

2+ years of cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting experience.

Excellent spoken and written American English: clear, neutral, and easy for U.S. business owners to understand.

Confident, professional phone presence and ability to follow a script without sounding robotic or overly "salesy."

Collaborate with the sales team to refine outreach and improve booking rates.

Specific targets will be set after training. Performance is measured on:

Completed outbound calls per day

Booked appointment show rate (those who actually attend)

Organized follow-up completion

We'll let you know now, this job is hard. Most of your calls will end in a no, a hang-up, a gatekeeper, or voi

Reliable power setup with a UPS (uninterruptible power supply) to bridge short outages without dropping calls; backup power for longer interruptions is strongly preferred.

Reliable wired internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps; 50+ Mbps preferred).

Quiet, dedicated workspace for calls.

Quality headset with microphone.

Desktop or laptop computer (Windows 10/11 or macOS).

Backup internet (mobile hotspot or secondary connection) in case of outages.



Compensation & Schedule

Pay: $5 USD per hour, part time

Performance bonus: $150 USD for each qualified appointment that turns into a closed sale.

ADDITIONAL BONUS - Pay Increase: Hit 12+ held demos in a month on your part-time schedule and earn $5.50/hour the next month. Hit 20+ and earn $6/hour the next month.

Hours: Monday to Friday, U.S. 10 AM to 2 PM EST / 11 PM to 3 AM PHT

title: Account Manager
description:
Please read the Job post - (DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT HAVE THE REQUIRED EXPERIENCE)



Account Manager

Work Setup: Remote, Full Time

Schedule: 40 hours per week 9:00AM to 6:00 PM EST

Salary: Php 40,000-Php 50,000



We are seeking a confident, highly organized, and detail-oriented Account Manager to support our U.S. clients, conduct discovery calls and sales presentations, manage client relationships, and oversee daily operations for our remote workforce.



This is NOT a traditional recruiting or cold-calling position. We need someone who can communicate confidently with U.S. business clients while ensuring that our existing clients and virtual assistants receive exceptional service.



Key Responsibilities



Client-Facing Sales & Presentations

-Conduct discovery calls and present StaffWiz solutions to prospective clients and staffing agencies.

-Understand client requirements and recommend appropriate workforce solutions.

-Prepare proposals, coordinate follow-ups, and support client onboarding.



Client Servicing & Account Management

-Manage day-to-day communication with assigned U.S. clients.

-Address client requests, resolve concerns, and maintain strong relationships.

-Monitor client satisfaction and proactively identify service issues.



VA Management & Operations

-Oversee daily operational coordination for virtual assistants assigned to clients.

-Manage onboarding, offboarding, attendance exceptions, leave requests, and scheduling.

-Coordinate VA concerns, performance issues, HR matters, and payroll information with the appropriate teams.

-Maintain accurate client records, employee documentation, and operational trackers.

-Ensure timely follow-ups and smooth service delivery.



Recruitment Coordination

-Coordinate with recruiters on client requirements, interviews, candidate updates, and placements.



Qualifications

-3+ years of experience in client-facing staffing, outsourcing, BPO account management, or workforce operations.

-Proven experience conducting client meetings, consultations, or sales presentations.

-Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence communicating with U.S. clients.

-Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

-Experience supporting client accounts and managing remote employees or virtual assistants.

-Familiarity with CRM systems, spreadsheets, and business productivity tools.

-Ability to work independently during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Requirement: Updated CV and intro video (Detailing your relevant experience)

title: Senior Accountant – US Accounting |
description:
Job Responsibilities



Maintain general ledger accounts and prepare journal entries.



Perform monthly balance sheet, bank, and intercompany reconciliations.



Assist with month-end and year-end closing.



Prepare financial statements and supporting schedules.



Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies.



Assist with inventory accounting and cost of goods sold (COGS).



Perform account and variance analysis.



Assist with audit requirements and documentation.



Work closely with the GL Manager and Controller.



Qualifications



Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, Accounting, or a related field.



At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience.



CPA license is not required.



Experience with US accounting or US GAAP is preferred.



Experience with QuickBooks Online or other accounting and ERP systems.



Strong Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills.



Good analytical and problem-solving skills.



Able to work independently with minimal supervision.



Good English communication skills.



Work Schedule and Compensation



Full-time, permanent work-from-home position.



Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM US Pacific Time.



Starting rate: $7 per hour plus paid overtime.



Long-term employment opportunity.



Immediate availability preferred.



Application Questions



How many years of professional accounting experience do you have?



Have you handled month-end closing and general ledger reconciliations independently?



Have you worked with US-based companies or US GAAP?



Do you have experience with inventory accounting and cost of goods sold?



What accounting software or ERP systems have you used?



Are you available to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM US Pacific Time?



Are you comfortable with the starting rate of $9 per hour plus paid overtime?



Are you able to commit to this position full-time?



When are you available to start?



Interested applicants should submit their updated resume and responses to the questions above.
